title: FULL STACK DEVELOPER
description:
**Company Description**
Anytime Diesel is India’s leading doorstep fuel delivery and fuel management company, transforming how businesses access and manage energy. Powered by advanced technology including IoT systems, GPS tracking, geo-fencing, AI, and data-driven fuel intelligence, the company delivers safe, reliable, tamper-proof, and on-time diesel to diverse commercial customers. With more than 10,000 clients across sectors such as infrastructure, healthcare, real estate, retail, and hospitality, Anytime Diesel focuses on reducing downtime, preventing fuel theft, and improving transparency. Its solutions include smart fuel storage tanks, Diesel Cube systems, and Fuelistic IoT logistics technology, creating a comprehensive, compliant fuel management ecosystem. Through its Fuel for Trees initiative, the company emphasizes responsible, efficient, and sustainable energy use, aligning growth with environmental responsibility.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a hands-on Full Stack Developer with DevOps capabilities to build, deploy and operate the applications that power Anytime Diesel. You will develop features across PHP and Java back-end services and React Native mobile applications, while owning reliable AWS deployments, automation, monitoring and production support. This role combines product engineering with infrastructure ownership in a fast-growing technology-led business.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Design, develop and maintain scalable features across PHP and Java services and React Native applications for iOS and Android.

·  Build secure REST APIs and integrate them with MySQL and Firebase, including Authentication, Firestore or Realtime Database, and Cloud Messaging.

·  Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated builds, testing and low-disruption deployments.

·  Provision, configure and manage AWS infrastructure, including EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC and CloudWatch, using Infrastructure as Code where appropriate.

· Monitor application health; implement logging and alerts; troubleshoot incidents and lead root-cause analysis.

·  Improve cloud security, application performance, uptime, reliability and infrastructure cost efficiency.

· Participate in code reviews, sprint planning and technical design discussions; maintain clear technical documentation.

· Build and maintain scalable web and mobile applications supporting customer bookings, order processing, delivery tracking and operational workflows.

· Develop integrations with payment gateways, GPS/location services, notifications and other third-party services as business requirements demand.

·  Implement robust API validation, error handling, authentication, authorization and audit trails.

·  Own release processes, environment configuration, application monitoring, rollback procedures and production incident resolution.

·  Implement automated unit, integration and API tests, ensuring deployment readiness.

·  Optimize application performance, cloud resource utilization and database interactions in coordination with the Database Engineer.

**Required Skills & Experience**

·   4+ years of hands-on full stack development experience (overall role target: 4–8 years).

·   Strong proficiency in PHP (Laravel or a comparable framework) and/or Java (Spring Boot).

·  Production experience with React Native apps on Android and iOS, including publishing to Google Play and the Apple App Store.

·  Strong MySQL fundamentals: SQL queries, indexing and basic performance optimization.

·  Practical knowledge of AWS services and Linux administration.

·   Hands-on CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Jenkins, along with Git workflows.

·   Experience integrating Firebase services into production applications.

·   Sound understanding of REST APIs, JWT/OAuth authentication and secure coding practices.

**Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills**

·   Docker, Kubernetes or AWS ECS.

·   Terraform or AWS Cloud Formation for Infrastructure as Code.

·   Monitoring platforms such as Grafana, Prometheus or Datadog.

·   AWS certification (Solutions Architect, Developer or DevOps Engineer).

·   Automated testing with PHPUnit, JUnit or Jest.

**Education**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**What Success Looks Like**

·  Reliable release pipelines and predictable deployments across development and production environments.

·  Secure, maintainable applications and APIs supporting day-to-day business operations.

·  Faster incident detection and resolution through proactive monitoring and root-cause analysis.

·  Continuous improvements in performance, availability and cloud cost discipline.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**Job description**

Snaphomz is building an AI-first real estate platform that helps buyers, sellers, and agents make confident decisions across discovery, evaluation, negotiation, and transactions. Our platform blends modern frontend experiences, serverless cloud infrastructure, AI orchestration, and real-world data integrations to deliver practical, scalable products used by real customers.

Were looking for an experienced full-stack developer who thrives in a startup environment and enjoys building systems end-to-end. This role is ideal for someone who can take ownership from idea to deployment and understands how frontend, backend, cloud, and AI systems come together.

**Role Overview**

You will play a key role in building, optimizing, and scaling the Snaphomz platform. You’ll work closely with AI, product, and design teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and well-designed applications. Your work will span modern frontend dashboards and tools, backend APIs and AI service orchestration, and cloud infrastructure that supports static hosting, serverless workloads, and global delivery.

You will contribute directly to user-facing experiences such as agent dashboards, conversational search interfaces, and internal tools, while also building the backend services and pipelines that integrate with external systems like MLS organizations, payment systems, auth services, and other relevant third party integrations. This is a hands-on role with real ownership and visible impact.

**Responsibilities**

* You will design, build, and maintain the Snaphomz web platform using Next.js, React, Node.js, and modern frontend best practices.
* You will develop backend services and APIs using Node.js and Python frameworks such as FastAPI and Flask, powering AI-driven workflows, integrations, and data pipelines.
* You will work extensively with AWS, including static hosting and global delivery using S3, CloudFront, and Route 53, and serverless application development using Lambda, API Gateway, and event-driven patterns.
* You will implement and manage email and notification workflows using services such as SES, and understand how these components fit together in production environments. Infrastructure will be treated as code.
* You will define, generate, and maintain deployment pipelines using AWS CDK, Docker containers, and YAML-based configurations.
* You will be responsible for understanding and improving deployment procedures, environment management, and release workflows.
* You will design and work with scalable data models using MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Firebase, ensuring performance, reliability, and clean abstractions.
* You will integrate external APIs such as MLS, Plaid, and Realfinity to support property, financial, and transactional data flows.
* You will collaborate closely with AI engineers to integrate LangChain or Emergent E1 agents, TorchServe models, and RAG-based APIs into production systems.
* You will help implement real-time features including notifications, event tracking, and custom CRM-like functionality, and optimize performance through caching strategies and CDN layers. CI/CD is a core part of the role.
* You will set up, maintain, and improve pipelines using GitHub Actions, ensuring smooth deployments across platforms such as AWS, Vercel, GCP, or OCI.
* You will maintain clean, modular, and well-documented code, follow best practices, and participate actively in code reviews and technical discussions.
* You will also explore, evaluate, and implement modern AI and automation tools, including components from Google Labs and Vertex AI, where they add real product value.

**Skills & Qualifications**

**Must-Have**

* 2–5 years of hands-on experience in full-stack development
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript with Next.js and React
* Solid backend experience with Node.js and Python (FastAPI or Flask)
* Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, data modeling, and distributed systems
* Hands-on experience with AWS services including S3, Cognito, CloudFront, Route 53, Lambda, API Gateway, and SES
* Experience with Docker, containerized deployments, and YAML-based configuration
* Experience with MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Firebase Authentication
* CI/CD experience using GitHub Actions and Git-based workflows
* Experience integrating AI services such as OpenAI, Gemini, LangChain, or equivalent
* Strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills

**Nice-to-Have**

* Experience in proptech, fintech, or real estate-related integrations
* Prior work on multi-tenant SaaS platforms or data-heavy dashboards
* Exposure to RAG architectures, AI orchestration, and agentic workflows
* Familiarity with serverless patterns, GraphQL, or gRPC
* Experience with Vertex AI, Google Labs tools, or similar AI platforms

**Why Join Snaphomz**

You’ll work on true end-to-end product ownership, from concept to production, for a US-based entity. You’ll collaborate with AI engineers, data scientists, and designers shaping the next generation of real estate technology. You’ll have the opportunity to experiment with cutting-edge AI and automation tools while building systems that actually ship and scale. Snaphomz offers a growth-focused startup culture with real autonomy, clear impact, and meaningful technical challenges.

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of professional

software engineering experience and strong hands-on expertise in Golang and React.js.

The ideal candidate will have experience building scalable, high-performance backend services and modern web applications. The candidate should have a strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, API design, frontend architecture, real-time systems, cloud technologies, and engineering best practices.

The role requires an engineer who can work across the entire technology stack, take ownership of end-to-end features, solve complex technical problems, and contribute to engineering excellence across teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Full Stack Engineering**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-performance applications using Golang and React.js.
* Build production-grade backend services, APIs, microservices, and frontend applications.
* Develop reusable and maintainable React components and frontend libraries.

title: Full-Stack Developer
description:

**About Revun**
Revun is the software platform and infrastructure layer behind modern property operations. Where other tools solve one piece of the puzzle, Revun unifies leasing, payments, maintenance, communications, compliance, reporting, and brokerage workflows into a single operating system. Owners, property managers, brokerages, leasing teams, maintenance companies, and REITs all operate from the same connected platform, with role-based experiences that adapt to each stakeholder. * At least 4 years of hands-on experience in web development with SaaS or client applications.

Nice to have

CAD $18,000 to $30,000 per year.

title: Principal Engineer - Full Stack
description:
A different kind of organization
  
  

* High trust, transparency, and autonomy
* Small teams, high ownership, flat structures
* Radical compensation transparency
* Sense of ownership in collective success
* Work with exceptional people who deeply care about their craft

The role
  
  
As a Principal Consultant, you're often the first person a customer meets to brainstorm a business problem. You should be at home debating distributed systems with engineers and framing decisions with leadership. You'll frame the problem with customers, shape the approach with the team, provide technical direction, and stay hands-on through delivery. You will work in self-managing, experienced, small, and high-impact teams, solving hard problems. This is a consulting & tech delivery role and while you will not have direct reports, you will regularly influence teams, mentor practitioners, manage stakeholders, and guide organisations through complex technology and business decisions.
  
  
What the work looks like
  
  
We can't promise which problem you'll pick up, but the menu right now looks something like this:
  
  

* Redesign a ClickHouse schema so an ad buyer can query 85 billion rows in under two seconds, and discover that pre-exploding the rows 168x is actually the right answer.
* Keep a vehicle telemetry platform moving billions of messages a day without the Kafka consumers falling over.
* Build the engineering spine of a mobile wallet used by more than two billion people across four continents.
* Ship the data product behind peer-review submissions for one of the world's largest scientific publishers.

The list changes every quarter. The pattern doesn't: data-heavy, distributed, and often sitting on top of something that already exists and isn't perfect.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  
Frame Problems & Propose Solutions
  
  

* Help customers find the right problem before jumping to a solution.
* Facilitate discovery sessions, architecture reviews, and technical workshops.
* Translate business goals into a technology strategy and an execution plan.

Lead Through Technical Excellence
  
  

* Stay hands-on; contribute directly to design, architecture, implementation, and review.
* Make pragmatic calls balancing business needs, engineering quality, and delivery timelines.
* Guide teams to build scalable, resilient, secure systems and the practices that keep them that way.

Influence, Advise, and align
  
  

* Act as a trusted advisor on technology and investment decisions; assessments, due diligence, advisory.
* Build trust and alignment across Sahaj and customer teams
* Converge competing priorities into a path forward.
* Communicate complex ideas clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Shape new work through discovery and proposals; mentor others and raise the bar as you go.

Operate Across Technology Domains
  
  
Distributed systems, data engineering, AI & agentic systems, DevOps/SRE. Depth in few areas; breadth across, and appreciation for trade-offs in context.
  
  
You'll thrive here if
  
  

* You reach for the simplest solution that gets the job done and distrust accidental complexity.
* You think in systems, not isolated parts.
* You stay calm when the path is unclear and build clarity for those around you.
* You move easily between the org-level picture and the technical detail.
* You're curious by default and pick up new domains fast.
* You'd rather be in the room with a customer solving a real problem.

What we're looking for
  
  

* 12+ years building software systems in complex environments.
* Strong engineering fundamentals; expert in at least one language, ideally polyglot.
* Hands-on experience designing and delivering distributed systems at scale.
* Deep grasp of architecture, system design, and engineering trade-offs.
* Direct experience working with customers and business stakeholders.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer L4
description:
**Who We Are**
Inovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology – and data specifically – would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. At Inovalon, we focus on empowering our customers with data-driven solutions, operating under a mission-based culture of inclusion and innovation. As ONE Inovalon, we deliver value to our customers and to the millions of patients and members they serve.
  
  
**Who You Are**
You are a Senior Software Development Engineer L4 who designs, builds, and optimizes scalable software solutions that support reporting, analytics, and business intelligence capabilities for clients. You help shape architecture, engineering standards, and delivery practices across the team. You bring strong technical judgment, reporting and data experience, and focus on building secure, reliable, high-performance systems supporting business outcomes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design resilient, secure distributed systems from concept through implementation to support reporting, analytics, and business intelligence capabilities at scale.
* Lead technical decisions to improve scalability, resiliency, security, performance, and engineering quality across services and solutions.
* Review and influence system designs, architecture, and standards for building and maintaining scalable software.
* Investigate and implement innovative technologies that expand infrastructure capabilities and improve reporting solution reliability and performance.
* Develop detailed designs for complex systems with strong engineering analysis, testing, and optimization practices.
* Create and use metrics to manage server fleets and complex computing environments — driving automation, operational efficiency, and performance improvements.
* Own design, analysis, testing, and optimization to ensure solutions are reliable, maintainable, and high performing.
* Collaborate with engineers, internal teams, and external customers to understand requirements and maintain a data-driven feedback loop.
* Mentor and onboard team members to support knowledge sharing and ongoing team success.
* Participate in an on-call rotation to address critical issues outside standard business hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays within defined SLAs.

**What You'll Need**

* Minimum 5+ years of related professional experience; prior software engineering experience preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Strong programming skills in object-oriented languages, including .NET and C#, with experience developing RESTful APIs and EF Core mapping.
* Proficiency with Angular and TypeScript.
* Experience with SQL, RDS, and DynamoDB.
* Solid understanding of software and database design patterns.
* Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and design for performance, scalability, and availability.
* Experience with cloud-native AWS managed services, containers, Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD.
* Experience with OAuth2, JWT, and Secrets Manager.
* Growth potential and learning agility to learn new technologies quickly, expand technical scope, and apply new knowledge to improve systems and outcomes.
* Leadership in influencing technical direction, collaborating across engineering and partner teams, mentoring, and constructively working through differing viewpoints.
* Adaptability to adjust priorities and technical approaches in response to changing requirements, evolving architecture, and operational demands.
* Creative thinking to identify practical, innovative ways to solve infrastructure, reporting, and scalability challenges.
* Analytical skills using metrics, data, and engineering logic to evaluate tradeoffs, solve complex problems, and support technical decisions.

**Our Shared Commitments**

* Maintain compliance with Inovalon’s policies, procedures, and mission statement.
* Adhere to all confidentiality and HIPAA requirements at all times regarding any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in this position.
* Fulfill responsibilities and duties reasonably provided by Inovalon to achieve operational and financial success.

**Work Environment**

* This is primarily a computer-based role performed in a remote, hybrid, or office environment. The role requires prolonged periods of computer use and frequent communication, either virtually or in person. Occasional transport or movement of work-related equipment weighing up to 10 pounds (such as a laptop) may be required. Some travel may occur, depending on role needs. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions, consistent with applicable law.

*This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship (e.g. H-1B, TN, or E-3). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States as a condition of employment. (This is only applicable for US-based positions)*

*By embracing inclusion, we enhance our work environment and drive business success. Inovalon strives to provide equal opportunities to the communities where we operate and to our clients and everyone whom we serve. Synechron is seeking a Java Fullstack Developer to develop, maintain, and enhance Java-based applications and systems. * Familiarity with frontend integration, reusable web components, responsive design, or frontend testing.

* Experience using Git or an equivalent version control system.
* Experience with code reviews, debugging, defect resolution, testing, and software development lifecycle activities.
* Ability to follow coding standards, branching practices, release processes, and documentation requirements.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams during iterative software delivery.

****Preferred****

* Experience with automated unit, integration, API, or web application testing.
* Familiarity with continuous integration and continuous delivery practices.
* Experience with build automation, code-quality analysis, issue tracking, logging, and application monitoring tools.
* Exposure to iterative development, technical estimation, and release planning.

****Essential****

* Understanding of secure application development practices for Java applications, web systems, databases, and RESTful services.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
* 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products.
* 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
* 5 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* Proven experience with contribution towards software design and architecture, demonstrating smooth production rollouts, due deligence and landing of complex systems in production.
* Familiarity with payments/compliance domain.
* Good exposure to the full collection of Google’s big-data infra (Flume, Storage), and experimentation infra (Rasta, Mendel).

**About The Job**
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
  
  
As a Senior Software Engineer, you will take end-to-end ownership of different workstreams across the screening platform. You will operate with high autonomy, translating ambiguous organizational goals into clear technical roadmaps. You will research, identify, and lead critical problems for the team to solve. Partnering alongside a peer tech lead, you will carve out multi-quarter technical initiatives, establish architectural direction, and multiply the output of a talented pool of engineers.
  
  
Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Fulfillment Technology (AFT), Platform Engineering and Services
description:
**Description**
Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) powers the physical engine at the heart of Amazon — magically turning your click of a button into packages at your door. Within AFT, the Labor Insights team builds and operates the platform that tracks on associate labor performance across Amazon's entire global warehouse network. Labor Insights' suite of 18+ services supports ~1 million associates and 70,000+ daily portal users across 9,800+ facilities and 10 business lines — ingesting over 19 billion labor events annually to produce the real-time productivity reports that warehouse managers rely on to run their operations every day. We leverage AWS technologies, stream processing, and AI/ML to build distributed, highly available systems that operate at massive scale.
  
  
Are you ready for a challenge? As a Software Development Engineer on the Labor Insights team, you will build the next generation of Amazon's labor management platform — designing systems that ingest billions of labor events from warehouse floor tools and time clock systems, aggregate them through multi-stage pipelines, and serve real-time productivity reports to operations managers across the globe. You will own design and development of distributed systems that refresh reports every 10–15 minutes across 3 global regions while maintaining 99.9% availability. You will contribute to a wide range of projects — from event processing pipelines and aggregation engines to reporting APIs, modern React-based portals, and AI-powered configuration tools. Most excitingly, you will help drive refresh of the existing tool, an AI-first greenfield initiative to rebuild the platform from the ground up using modern stream-based architecture, eliminating a decade of technical debt and delivering near real-time metrics. You will be involved in all aspects of the software development cycle including scoping, design, implementation, testing, and delivery. A commitment to teamwork, hustle, and strong communication skills are absolute requirements. Creating reliable, scalable, and high-performance services requires exceptional technical expertise. If you have that expertise, are customer-centric, and motivated about building systems that operate at global scale, then we want to talk to you!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and test software components across Labor Insights' ingestion, aggregation, reporting, and configuration layers — handling labor events, time clock punches, employee location tracking, and productivity report generation
* Build new services using AI-assisted development practices, leveraging tools like Amazon Q and Bedrock to achieve high-velocity delivery on greenfield systems
* Design large-scale data processing solutions using DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, S3, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, Lambda, and stream processing frameworks (Cosmos/Flink) optimized for high throughput and low-latency access
* Drive service consolidation and modernization — migrating from legacy infrastructure to Native AWS (NAWS) with full CI/CD pipelines
* Participate in definition of coding standards and apply them in code and design reviews
* Provide estimates for development tasks and negotiate timelines with project leaders
* Mentor junior team members and help them acquire critical skills and best practices
* Document and communicate technical concepts to team members and stakeholders
* Participate in deep technical discussions, where you stand up for your ideas and work with team members to find the best solution for the customer
* Identify technical and project risks and take initiative to mitigate them

A day in the life
  
  
Full-cycle ownership. You contribute to all aspects of the software development cycle — from scoping and design through implementation, testing, and delivery of features that provide labor performance visibility to Amazon's global fulfillment operations.
  
  
Billions-scale data processing. You build systems that ingest 19+ billion labor events per year from warehouse floor tools, time clock systems, and employee location heartbeats. You design multi-stage aggregation pipelines that process this data into PPR and PPA reports refreshed every 10–15 minutes, served to 70K+ daily users across 9,800+ facilities.
  
  
AWS-native architecture. You leverage the full AWS stack — DynamoDB for hot data storage, S3 for historical data, PostgreSQL for aggregated reports, SQS/SNS for event-driven processing, EventBridge and Lambda for serverless job orchestration, and Cosmos/Flink for stream processing. You architect for 99.9% availability across 3 global regions (NA, EU, FE).
  
  
AI-first development. You pioneer AI-assisted engineering practices — using Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Q, and AI-powered tools to accelerate greenfield development at 20X traditional velocity. You build intelligent systems like AI-powered configuration assistants, automated intake routing, and GenAI-driven operational tooling.
  
  
Modernization at scale. You modernize a 15+ year-old platform serving every fulfillment center worldwide — consolidating 23+ services into a clean microservices architecture, rebuilding the portal experience in React from legacy JSP/jQuery, and transitioning from batch to stream processing, all while maintaining zero-downtime operations.
  
  
**About The Team**
About Labor Insights: We build Amazon's global labor management platform — the system of record for measuring associate performance across every fulfillment center, sort center, delivery station, and grocery facility worldwide. Labor Insights tracks how ~1 million associates spend their time, producing the productivity reports (PPR, PPA, attendance, Time Off Task) that operations managers use to make staffing decisions, identify bottlenecks, and ensure customer shipments go out on time.
  
  
**What Makes This Role Exciting**

* Build FCLM 2.0 from the ground up — a once-in-a-career opportunity to greenfield a platform that runs Amazon's global workforce visibility, using AI-first development to deliver in months what would take years through traditional approaches
* Pioneer stream processing — transition from batch to real-time with sub-minute latencies using Cosmos/Flink, fundamentally changing how Amazon tracks labor performance
* Build a multi-tenant platform (FCLM FLEX) — design a configurable translation layer that recasts PPR and PPA as flexible views on the same underlying data, eliminating duplicate pipelines and enabling third-party teams to create custom labor views without engineering support
* Reimagine the portal experience — rebuild the portal used by 70K+ daily users from legacy JSP/jQuery into a modern React application with accessibility, localization, and scalable access controls
* Expand to new businesses — onboard Amazon Grocery (Fresh, Whole Foods) and other new business lines in 2026+, scaling the platform to new node types and labor models
* Build AI-powered tools — design intelligent systems using Amazon Bedrock for automated configuration management, request intake, and operational copilots that serve 1.5M workers globally
* Massive impact — every feature you build is used by tens of thousands of warehouse managers the same day; Labor Insights’ operations save an estimated $25M+ annually

**Our Tenets**

* Build for Scale: Design generically to support multiple use cases beyond Labor Insights
* Service Generalization for Multi-Tenancy: Build abstractions that work across all businesses
* No Data Filtering by Default: Accept all incoming data, build flexible views on top

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**

title: Associate IS Engineer
description:
**About Amgen**
Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases and make people’s lives easier, fuller, and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains at the cutting edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what is known today.
  
  
**Role Description**
We are seeking an Associate IS Engineer to support the delivery, operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of enterprise applications and digital solutions.
  
  
This is a blended application engineering role combining IT application support, application lifecycle management, technical troubleshooting, integration support, and software development. The successful candidate will work across both run/support activities and change/development initiatives, helping ensure applications remain reliable, secure, compliant, and fit for business needs.
  
  
Working under the guidance of senior engineers, the Associate IS Engineer will investigate and resolve application and integration issues, support application releases and upgrades, participate in incident and problem management, maintain application documentation and configurations, and work with business, infrastructure, platform, security, and vendor teams.
  
  
The role will also contribute to full-stack development and application enhancements, including front-end development, API integration, back-end development, testing, and deployment where required.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Provide day-to-day technical and operational support for enterprise applications and associated integrations which could be either of these SaaS, COTS and Custom-built application
* Monitor application health, availability, interfaces, scheduled jobs, and other operational components, and proactively identify potential issues.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve application incidents, defects, integration failures, data issues, and performance problems.
* Perform technical root-cause analysis and support implementation of corrective and preventive measures for recurring problems.
* Support incident, problem, request, and change-management processes in accordance with established IT service-management practices.
* Work with business users, application owners, infrastructure teams, security teams, integration teams, and external vendors to resolve technical issues.
* Support application configuration, upgrades, patches, releases, environment changes, and production deployments.
* Support application integrations with enterprise platforms, databases, APIs, identity and access-management solutions, and cloud services.
* Maintain application documentation including architecture and interface details, configuration information, operational procedures, troubleshooting guides, and support knowledge articles.
* Contribute to application lifecycle activities including technical assessments, upgrades, modernization, remediation, and application retirement where applicable.
* Participate in periodic operational, security, compliance, and application health activities as required.

**Software Development & Enhancement**

* Contribute to the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of application enhancements and software solutions.
* Manage the application SDLC and supporting ITIL Lifecyle completely
* Translate business and technical requirements into maintainable and user-friendly application functionality.
* Develop or enhance front-end applications using technologies such as React, Vite, TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
* Build reusable, responsive, accessible user-interface components following enterprise design standards.
* Integrate applications with RESTful APIs, enterprise services, databases, and third-party platforms.
* Contribute to back-end development using Python and FastAPI, or comparable technologies, under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Participate in technical design discussions, peer code reviews, troubleshooting sessions, and technical walkthroughs.
* Follow coding standards, secure-development practices, reusable software-design patterns, and established engineering practices.
* Develop and maintain appropriate unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end automated tests.
* Support CI/CD processes for automated builds, testing, security scanning, and deployment.
* Analyse and remediate application vulnerabilities, software dependency issues, and technical debt in collaboration with senior engineers.

**Testing, Release & Operational Readiness**

* Create and execute functional, integration, regression, smoke, and end-to-end tests for application changes and releases.
* Support user acceptance testing and resolution of defects identified during testing.
* Validate APIs and system integrations using tools such as Postman or equivalent.
* Support release planning, deployment validation, and post-production verification.
* Ensure appropriate technical and support documentation is available before solutions transition into production.
* Work with support teams to ensure operational readiness for new applications, enhancements, integrations, and releases.

**Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

* Collaborate with product managers, business stakeholders, application owners, developers, QA professionals, DevOps teams, infrastructure teams, cybersecurity teams, and external vendors.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, demonstrations, and retrospectives.
* Identify opportunities to improve application reliability, automate repetitive operational activities, and reduce recurring support issues.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and practices across application development, cloud, DevOps, API integration, observability, cybersecurity, automation, and AI.

**Basic Qualifications And Experience**

* Master's / Bachelor’s degree with 3–5 years of relevant experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience may include a combination of application development, application engineering, production/application support, system integration, testing, or IT operations.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Good understanding of information systems, application architecture, software-development lifecycle, and application-support lifecycle.
* Experience supporting business or enterprise applications in development, test, and/or production environments.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to investigate application incidents, software defects, integration failures, and data-related issues.
* Understanding of incident, problem, change, and release-management processes.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs and application integrations.
* Understanding of relational databases, SQL, and basic data-access concepts.
* Hands-on experience with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and/or TypeScript.
* Familiarity with React and Vite, Angular, Vue.js, or another modern front-end framework.
* Basic knowledge of Python and FastAPI, or a comparable back-end technology.
* Experience developing, testing, debugging, supporting, and deploying software applications.
* Understanding of software-testing methodologies including functional, integration, regression, smoke, end-to-end, and user acceptance testing.
* Experience creating and executing test cases and documenting test results.
* Familiarity with unit and UI testing frameworks such as Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, Playwright, Selenium, or equivalent tools.
* Familiarity with API testing using Postman or equivalent tools.
* Familiarity with defect and work-management platforms such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Familiarity with Git-based version control, branching, pull requests, and code reviews.
* Understanding of Agile and Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment.
* Understanding of secure coding principles, OWASP guidance, authentication, authorization, dependency management, and application security.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with business users, technical teams, and external vendors.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Exposure to GxP or regulated systems and associated validation/compliance activities.

* Experience working with SaaS and/or vendor-managed enterprise applications.
* Understanding of cloud platforms and cloud-hosted application architectures.
* Exposure to monitoring, logging, alerting, or application observability tools.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Full stack) - Security & Trust
description:
Truveta is the world's first health provider led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta's ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software, and big data experience who share our company values.
  
  
This role is based in the greater Seattle area, with our office located in Hyderabad, India.
  
  
Who We Need
  
  
Truveta is rapidly building a talented and diverse team to tackle complex health and technical challenges. Beyond core capabilities, we are seeking problem solvers, passionate and collaborative teammates, and those willing to roll up their sleeves while making a difference. If you are interested in the opportunity to pursue purposeful work, join a mission-driven team, and build a rewarding career while having fun, Truveta may be the perfect fit for you.
  
  
This Opportunity
  
  
Patients, doctors, and medical researchers deserve to benefit from the same large-scale technological innovation and digital intelligence that have driven progress in office productivity, entertainment, and social networking. We are looking for a Full Stack Senior Software Engineer excited by the opportunity to improve health care in far-reaching ways. In this role, you will lead and build modern, scalable software solutions across the full stack to streamline our engineering processes and accelerate our mission.
  
  
You will collaborate with internal users to analyze their use cases, requirements, and expectations, and lead the design and development of scalable, secure, and cost-effective cloud-based software solutions that remove inefficiencies and pain points, enabling our users to deliver faster and do more.
  
  
This role also gives you the opportunity to work closely with other senior and principal software engineers across the company to help define our software future direction and long-term strategy, and to influence technology selection in ways that make a significant impact on our business success. You will also mentor and guide junior software engineers, helping to improve their code quality and security practices and supporting their growth by championing SDLC best practices.
  
  
We Are Seeking a Full Stack Senior Software Engineer Who:
  
  

* Has 7 plus years of strong expertise and hands-on experience in coding, testing, source control, CI/CD pipelines, and APIs in the cloud.
* Has proven experience building reliable, secure, and scalable software solutions using modern cloud-based paradigms, across both front-end and back-end.
* Is a quick learner who knows how to iterate and evolve a software solution while carefully balancing the needs of privacy, security, and reliability against a changing product landscape.
* Provides consultation and subject matter expertise for software development, rollout, and maintenance through the full software lifecycle.
* Leads major projects and program initiatives, participates in sprint planning, removes roadblocks, and ensures on-time delivery with quality.
* Is willing to review code developed by other software engineers and provide feedback to ensure best practices.
* Is willing to commit to ongoing training on key topics such as privacy, compliance, and security.
* Is willing to join an on-call rotation to triage production software issues and recover services quickly.

**Key Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent years of experience.
* Demonstrated working knowledge translating a business requirement into a functional design, development, testing, and implementation.
* 7+ years of coding experience building production-quality software in a team setting is required.
* 3+ years of experience building full stack cloud applications with technologies such as Python, .NET, Node.js, React, or Java is required.
* Strong experience with serverless RESTful APIs to support API-driven services for system-to-system usage.
* Strong experience with modern cloud-native platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure).
* Extensive hands-on experience with DevOps tools such as Git and CI/CD pipelines; Azure DevOps experience is a big plus.
* Prior work with the Azure platform, including Azure Functions/Web Apps and Azure Storage accounts, is a plus.
* Prior work with Azure Kubernetes Service and containerized application development is a plus.
* Knowledge of Azure security services such as Azure Networking, Azure Firewall, and Azure Key Vault is a plus.
* Extensive experience with testing frameworks for React, Node.js, and C#/.NET.

Why Truveta?
  
  
Be a part of building something special. Now is the perfect time to join Truveta. We have strong, established leadership with decades of success. We are well-funded. We are building a culture that prioritizes people and their passions across personal, professional, and everything in between. Join us as we build an amazing company together.
  
  
Truveta is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and empowering workplace. We believe that having employees with diverse backgrounds enables Truveta to better meet our mission and serve patients and health communities around the world.

title: Consultant
description:
**Overview**
Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Responsibilities**

* Embed with customer stakeholders to understand business workflows, constraints, and success metrics; translate ambiguous needs into clear requirements, solution hypotheses, and sprint deliverables for GenAI/agentic scenarios.
* Design and implement agentic and GenAI solutions on Microsoft platforms (e.g., Dynamics 365, M365 Copilots, Power Platform, Azure) including integrations, APIs, and automations that accelerate adoption and deliver measurable outcomes.
* Prototype rapidly, then harden to production: build POCs for agentic workflows (multi-step tasks, tool-use, orchestration), validate with users, and evolve to production-ready implementations with testing, monitoring, and secure deployment patterns.
* Own end-to-end delivery from architecture through implementation: define build/test specifications, create eval and quality gates for GenAI outputs, and produce operational guides/runbooks for reliability, safety, and maintainability.
* Identify and mitigate business/technical risks specific to AI systems (data access, prompt injection, hallucinations, privacy, compliance, latency, cost); propose safeguards and fallback behaviors for agentic flows.
* Support deployment and live stabilization: troubleshoot integrations and model behavior in real environments, iterate quickly, and ensure successful go-live with clear ownership, monitoring, and incident playbooks.
* Balance platform configuration with extensibility to maximize speed and maintainability. Co-engineer with customer teams to ensure knowledge transfer, documentation, and reusable patterns. Drive delivery plans across the full lifecycle—discovery, build, eval, deployment, and operations—accounting for dependencies across data, security, and enterprise systems.
* Build agentic workflows that invoke tools/APIs safely (function calling patterns), with guardrails, validation, and auditability.
* Implement evaluation strategies (offline/online) to measure output quality, groundedness, safety, and business impact.
* Capture repeatable assets (templates, reference architectures, accelerators) and share feedback loops with internal teams.

description:
Position Description
  
  
Company Profile:
  
  
At CGI, we’re a team of builders. We call our employees members because all who join CGI are building their own company - one that has grown to 94,000 professionals located in 40 countries. Founded in 1976, CGI is a leading IT and business process services firm committed to helping clients succeed. We have the global resources, expertise, stability and dedicated professionals needed to achieve.
  
  
This is a great opportunity to join a winning team. CGI offers a competitive compensation package with opportunities for growth and professional development. Benefits for full-time, permanent members start on the first day of employment and include a paid time-off program and profit participation and stock purchase plans. We wish to thank all applicants for their interest and effort in applying for this position, however, only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted. No unsolicited agency referrals please.
  
  
Your future duties and responsibilities
  
  
Job Title:MA Dynamics 365
  
  
Position: LA/AC
  
  
Experience: 9 yrs to 12 Yrs
  
  
Category: Software Development
  
  
Main location: Hyderabad.
  
  
Employment Type: Full time
  
  
Dynamics 365 Engineer – UKI SAPDecomEnabler
  
  
Role Purpose
  
  
CGI is looking for an experienced Microsoft Dynamics 365 Engineer supporting the modernisation of enterprise applications and the progressive transition of business capabilities and integrations away from legacy SAP dependent services.
  
  
The Dynamics 365 Engineer will design, build, test and maintain high quality solutions using Microsoft Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform, working within a cross functional engineering squad alongside Product, Architecture, QA, Operations and other technology teams.
  
  
The role requires strong Dynamics engineering capability together with experience in integrations, APIs, Power Platform, Azure services and modern software engineering practices.
  
  
Within the SAPDecomEnabler context, the engineer will work with relevant application and integration teams to understand existing SAP dependencies and help deliver Dynamics based capabilities and integrations required to support the target state architecture.
  
  
**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Dynamics 365 Engineering
* Design, develop, test and maintain scalable solutions using Microsoft Dynamics 365.
* Configure and customise Dynamics applications to meet agreed business requirements.
* Develop high quality, secure and maintainable solutions in accordance with established engineering standards.
* Develop and maintain Dynamics components including: Entities / tables Plugins Workflows Business logic Web resources Model driven applications Custom controls Integrations
* Analyse technical requirements and translate them into robust Dynamics solutions.
* Ensure solutions meet agreed functional and non functional requirements.
* SAP Decommissioning Enablement
* Work within the UKI SAPDecomEnabler squad to support the transition of relevant capabilities and dependencies away from legacy SAP services.
* Collaborate with SAP, application, architecture and business teams to understand existing process and integration dependencies.
* Identify where Dynamics 365 capabilities form part of the target state solution.
* Develop or enhance Dynamics functionality required to support processes transitioning away from SAP.
* Support the replacement or decoupling of SAP dependent interfaces where Dynamics is part of the target architecture.
* Work with integration teams to ensure downstream and upstream dependencies are understood and addressed.
* Support migration, cutover, validation and stabilisation activities associated with the transition.
* Ensure replacement capabilities are operationally ready before associated legacy dependencies are retired.
* Dynamics 365 & Power Platform
* Develop solutions using the Microsoft Power Platform alongside Dynamics 365.
* Build and enhance solutions using: Power Apps Power Automate Dataverse Model driven applications
* Automate business processes and workflows using appropriate Power Platform capabilities.
* Develop reusable components and patterns where appropriate.
* Ensure Power Platform solutions follow agreed governance, security and development standards.
* Integration Engineering
* Design and develop integrations between Dynamics 365 and other enterprise systems.
* Build and consume REST APIs and web services.
* Support integration with legacy/SAP applications during transition.
* Work with Azure based integration technologies where appropriate.
* Develop solutions using technologies such as: Azure Functions Azure Logic Apps Azure Service Bus APIs / Web Services
* Support event driven and asynchronous integration patterns.
* Ensure integrations are secure, resilient, observable and supportable.
* Troubleshoot complex integration and data flow issues across platforms.
* Software Development

Depending on the Dynamics solution area, develop and maintain solutions using relevant technologies including:
  
  

* C#
* .NET
* JavaScript
* TypeScript
* Dynamics plugins
* Workflow assemblies
* FetchXML
* Web resources
* APIs and web services

Apply appropriate coding standards, design patterns and engineering practices to ensure solutions are maintainable and scalable.
  
  

* CI/CD & DevOps
* Work with modern source control and CI/CD practices.
* Maintain application code and configuration within appropriate version control repositories.
* Build and support automated deployment pipelines for Dynamics and Power Platform solutions.
* Promote controlled and repeatable deployment across environments.
* Participate in code reviews and peer reviews.
* Implement automated testing where appropriate.
* Support continuous improvement of development and deployment practices.
* Ensure releases comply with Centrica change, security and engineering controls.
* Testing & Quality Engineering
* Take ownership of the quality of delivered Dynamics solutions.
* Develop and execute appropriate unit and technical testing.
* Support integration, system and user acceptance testing.
* Participate in peer/code reviews.
* Investigate and resolve defects proactively.
* Ensure technical solutions satisfy functional and non functional requirements.
* Support regression testing during SAP transition and decommissioning activities.
* Validate that changes do not adversely affect existing business processes and integrations.
* Security & Compliance
* Develop solutions in accordance with Centrica security and data protection requirements.
* Apply appropriate Dynamics security roles and access controls.
* Ensure customer and business data is handled responsibly.
* Follow secure software development practices.
* Consider security, privacy and compliance requirements throughout the development lifecycle.
* Work with Security and Architecture teams where design approval or specialist input is required.
* Performance, Resilience & Scalability
* Design Dynamics solutions with appropriate consideration for: Performance Availability Scalability Resilience Maintainability Supportability
* Identify and resolve performance issues.
* Ensure integrations can handle expected business volumes.
* Avoid unnecessary customisation where standard Dynamics/Power Platform capabilities can meet requirements effectively.
* Contribute to continuous platform optimisation.
* Live Service Support
* Support Dynamics solutions after deployment into production.
* Participate in incident investigation and technical troubleshooting.
* Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues.
* Resolve defects and production problems.
* Contribute to ongoing platform and service improvements.
* Ensure appropriate technical documentation and support knowledge is maintained.
* Support hypercare following major migrations or SAP decommissioning releases.
* Agile & Cross Functional Delivery
* Work as part of the UKI SAPDecomEnabler cross functional squad.
* Collaborate closely with: Product Owners Software Engineers SAP SMEs Solution/Technical Architects QA / Quality Engineering Security Infrastructure Integration teams Operations Business stakeholders
* Participate in sprint planning, refinement, stand ups, retrospectives and technical design discussions.
* Take ownership of agreed work items through to completion.
* Raise risks, blockers and dependencies early.
* Contribute positively to team delivery and continuous improvement.

Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  
The successful candidate should have strong hands on experience in:
  
  

* Microsoft Dynamics 365
* Dynamics 365 configuration and customisation
* C# / .NET
* JavaScript and/or TypeScript
* Dynamics plugins and workflows
* Power Apps
* Power Automate
* Dataverse
* REST APIs / Web APIs / Web Services
* Enterprise system integration
* Source control and CI/CD
* Automated testing and code review
* Secure software engineering practices

The candidate should also demonstrate:
  
  

* Experience working as a software engineer within a modern cross functional Agile/product squad.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Understanding of non functional requirements including performance, resilience and scalability.
* Experience supporting live enterprise applications.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem solving capability.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills.

Desirable Technical Skills
  
  
Experience in the following would be advantageous:
  
  

* Azure Functions
* Azure Logic Apps
* Azure Service Bus
* Azure DevOps
* Event driven architectures
* Asynchronous processing
* PCF Controls
* FetchXML
* Workflow Assemblies
* Dynamics Web Resources
* Power Platform governance
* Application monitoring and observability
* Cloud native integration patterns

SAP Transformation Experience – Highly Desirable
  
  
For the UKI SAPDecomEnabler squad, candidates with the following experience would be particularly valuable:
  
  

* Previous involvement in SAP transformation, migration or decommissioning programmes.
* Experience replacing business capabilities previously delivered through SAP.
* Experience decoupling enterprise applications from SAP integrations.
* Understanding of SAP to Dynamics integration patterns.
* Experience with enterprise data migration and interface transition.
* Experience identifying upstream/downstream system dependencies.
* Experience supporting technical cutover and hypercare.
* Understanding of controlled legacy system retirement.

Deep SAP development expertise is not necessarily required; the primary requirement is Dynamics engineering capability combined with the ability to work effectively with SAP and integration teams during the transition.
  
  
Dynamics Product Experience
  
  
Depending on the specific capability being transitioned, relevant experience may include one or more of:
  
  

* Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE)
* Dynamics 365 Customer Service
* Dynamics 365 Field Service
* Dynamics 365 Sales
* Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O)
* Power Platform / Dataverse

Candidates do not necessarily need deep expertise across every Dynamics product. The appropriate Dynamics specialisation should align with the specific business capability being transitioned by the squad.
  
  
Certifications – Desirable
  
  
Relevant Microsoft certifications would be advantageous, including:
  
  

* Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Developer
* Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer
* Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 Functional Consultant certifications
* Relevant Azure certifications

Key Competencies
  
  
Dynamics EngineeringStrong hands on capability to configure, customise, develop and support enterprise grade Dynamics solutions.
  
  
Integration Thinking: Understands how Dynamics interacts with APIs, Azure services, legacy platforms and other enterprise applications.
  
  
Problem Solving Able to investigate complex application and integration issues and identify practical technical solutions.
  
  
Engineering Quality: Produces secure, maintainable and well-tested code and takes ownership of quality throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  
  
Collaboration: Works effectively with Product, Architecture, SAP, QA, Security, Operations and other engineering teams.
  
  
Ownership: Takes responsibility for agreed deliverables, proactively identifies risks and follows issues through to resolution.
  
  
Continuous Improvement Actively improves engineering practices, automation, maintainability and platform capability.
  
  
Expected Outcomes
  
  
The Dynamics 365 Engineer will help the UKI SAPDecomEnabler squad to:
  
  

* Deliver Dynamics capabilities required by the target state architecture.
* Reduce business process and application dependencies on legacy SAP services.
* Build secure and scalable Dynamics solutions.
* Establish robust integrations between Dynamics and strategic enterprise platforms.
* Automate business processes using Dynamics and Power Platform.
* Improve maintainability through modern software engineering and DevOps practices.
* Ensure replacement services are production ready before legacy dependencies are retired.
* Support safe migration, cutover and stabilisation.
* Contribute to Centrica's wider technology modernisation objectives.

Candidate Profile
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands on Dynamics engineer rather than purely a Dynamics functional consultant.
  
  
They should be comfortable working across Dynamics configuration, custom development, Power Platform and enterprise integrations, while collaborating with architects, SAP teams and business stakeholders.
  
  
For this particular squad, the strongest candidate would combine:
  
  
Dynamics 365 + C#/.NET + Power Platform + APIs/Integration + Azure + modern engineering practices
  
  
with previous exposure to SAP transformation/decommissioning or complex legacy modernisation programmes.
  
  
Candidates with backgrounds such as Dynamics 365 Developer, Dynamics Engineer, CRM Developer, Power Platform/Dynamics Developer or Full Stack D365 Engineer would be particularly relevant.
  
  
**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**
Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…
  
  
You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.
  
  
Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.
  
  
You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
  
  
That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.
  
  
Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Forward Deployed Engineer**

You'll build on top of Saras IQ Product to own the solution and the build for a client requirement - from the first requirements conversation and live customer demos to validated data, one trusted set of metrics, live dashboards, and clean data every morning - as the accountable owner of what gets built as a repeatable product capability.

**About Saras Analytics**

Saras Analytics is an AI and data analytics firm built for ecommerce and omnichannel brands. We help fast growing SMBs and mid-market brands turn disconnected, messy data into decisions — covering ingestion, transformation, and consumption, backed by our own products (Daton and Saras IQ) as the data infrastructure in every engagement.

**Why Now**

Saras is profitable and bootstrapped. We run flat: talent and good ideas move fast here regardless of tenure or title. AI-assisted tooling now lets one engineer take a client from the first requirements conversation to a live, trusted dashboard without waiting on a queue of hand-offs. The Forward Deployed Engineer role is built around that: one owner, end to end, with the tooling to make it fast. Because you build on top of our products rather than around them, what you create for one client requirement becomes capability that every client can use. An FDE joining now helps define what that role looks like at its best.

**The Role**

You'll own the solution and the build for one client account, reporting to an FDE Lead. You build on top of our product, Saras IQ, extending it with software you design and code. You are responsible for interacting directly with the customer — running discovery, demoing what you build, and presenting it to client stakeholders — as well as with the product teams, and you contribute to the product roadmap. Whatever you build, you then become the advisor or implementer of that same capability in the product: you create repeatable solutions that expand what the product can do and maximize revenue impact. On that account you work alongside a Strategic Account Manager, who owns the client relationship and the commercial outcomes, and a Product Manager, who owns product onboarding, enablement, and roadmap, with you as a direct contributor to it. You own what gets built and whether it is right — requirements, software, data, metrics, dashboards, and data quality — with our AI-assisted tooling and our SME leads behind you for the hardest problems.

**The Bar**

Speed & Delivery quality are the top priorities for this role: what you ship is correct, validated against the source of truth before the client sees it, and there on the date you committed to. Speed matters because clients feel it — the shortest path from signed-off requirements to a live, trusted dashboard — but never at the cost of numbers the client can rely on. You build to product standard: what you write is well designed, tested, version-controlled, and reusable, because it is part of the product. You surface risks before they block delivery, and you close every issue with a root cause and a fix, you internally escalate the dependencies on time. The lanes are explicit: you own the solution and the build; the Account Manager owns the relationship and the commercial outcomes; the Product Manager owns product onboarding, enablement, and roadmap, with you as a direct contributor to it.

**What You'll Own**

**1. Own discovery and requirements.**
Join the sales handover to close open questions and call out risks early. Run discovery sessions directly with client stakeholders on the client's core use cases — sales and marketing, contribution margin, customer cohorts, product and inventory — co-design the solution with them, and write the business requirements and metric definitions using Saras' standard templates, reviewing them internally before client sign-off. Build the mock-ups that let clients react before anything is built, demo working builds live to the client at every milestone and take their feedback directly, write the test cases every requirement will be validated against, and track change requests so scope stays visible to you and the Account Manager.

**2. Own the data build.**
Set up integrations and access with our data-ingestion team, translate requirements into technical specifications, and build the staging, master, and presentation datasets with Saras' AI-assisted data-engineering tools, following our data-model conventions (dbt, BigQuery, Git). Apply PII masking, and keep the data dictionary and lineage documentation current. When a problem goes beyond your account — a complex architecture choice or a platform limit — take it to the senior data-engineering lead with a proposed workaround, and keep ownership of the outcome.

**3. Build on top of the product, end to end.**
You are not only modelling data: you build complete solutions on top of Saras IQ, and that takes software & data engineering & Analytics skills. Design and code the services, APIs, integrations, automation, and application logic around the data layer, and apply sound engineering practice — modular design, code review, automated tests, version control, and CI/CD. Write code that others can maintain and extend, because it may become part of the product.

**4. Turn what you build into product.**
Whatever you build, you become the advisor or implementer of that same capability in the product. Package it as a repeatable, configurable solution rather than a one-off, document it, and help other FDEs and accounts adopt it, so each engagement expands what the product can do and maximizes its revenue impact.

**5. Own the client's metric definitions.**
Configure one certified set of metrics and dimensions for each client in Saras IQ's semantic layer, so that every dashboard, self-serve question, and AI answer draws on the same definitions.

**6. Own validation before anything reaches the client**
. Reconcile every dataset against its source of truth, certify it, and run the internal sign-off against agreed criteria for sending work back. Set up the data quality and completeness checks, validate against the requirement test cases and against a benchmark set of business questions the AI analyst must answer correctly, then walk the Account Manager through the build in a final review before it goes to the client.

**7. Own the consumption layer.**
Build dashboards natively in Saras IQ (and in Tableau, Luzmo, or Power BI where the contract specifies), drawing their metrics from the client's certified definitions. Build and maintain the business context that powers Saras IQ Analyst, our AI analyst; set it up and provision it for client users in Slack and their AI tools; and keep refining that context from what users ask it. The Account Manager leads the launch and adoption, and the Product Manager leads enablement.

**8. Own data quality every day.**
Run the daily data-quality cycle: confirm the overnight pipelines and checks have completed, resolve what they flag, escalate anything still open — or late upstream data — to the senior data-engineering lead, re-run and re-test what you fixed, and send the client a routine data-quality status (with any help you need from them), copying the Account Manager. Configure latency and dashboard alerts, and close every bug and change request with a root cause and a fix. When an issue breaches its SLA or stays open past a day, the Account Manager takes the client escalation and you drive the fix.

**9. Run your delivery hygiene.**
Keep your onboarding and project documentation, task tracker, and timesheets current, so anyone can see where your account stands.

**10. Partner across the lanes.**
Be the direct technical voice to customers and to the product teams, and contribute to the product roadmap. Support your Account Manager with the technical answers behind success criteria, client acceptance testing, and adoption, and demo what you built and walk client users through its logic yourself, while the Account Manager owns the relationship and the commercial conversations; work with the Product Manager and the product teams to turn what you hear from customers and learn from your builds into roadmap priorities; and work with our data-ingestion and data-engineering teams to unblock ingestion, data quality, and architecture issues.

**What Winning Looks Like**

**First 90 days:**

you know your account's data and metric definitions in depth, you run the daily data-quality cycle reliably, and you've taken at least one deliverable from signed-off requirements to a validated, live dashboard on your own, demoing it to the client yourself.

**Steady state:**

you deliver datasets and dashboards independently and on the committed date, your validation catches issues before clients ever do, your client's mornings start with clean data, your FDE Lead trusts what you ship without re-checking every number, your teammates enjoy working with you, what you've built is reusable and part of the product, you contribute to the roadmap, and you're ready to own a new account launch end to end.

**Who Thrives Here**

Any of these backgrounds can get you in the room. Across all of them, you bring 3+ years (typically 3–6) of hands-on data and software work — some of it building in SQL and code, and some of it facing clients, including demos.

• You've been a business or data analyst who wrote requirements and specifications, worked hands-on in SQL, and are ready to own the build as well as the brief.

• You've been an analytics or data engineer who built layered data models — raw, staging, masters, presentation — and are ready to own the client conversation as well as the pipeline.

• You've delivered data or BI projects in an analytics consulting or services firm, end to end, directly with clients.

• You've been a software engineer who built backend or full-stack applications and data-heavy products, and are ready to take on analytics, data modelling, and the client conversation.

**Whichever route you come from, you have:**

• A degree from a reputed engineering college.

• Strong SQL and data-modelling fundamentals across the raw → staging → master → presentation layers.

• Software engineering fundamentals: proficiency in Python (or a comparable language such as Java, TypeScript, or Go), data structures, and the ability to write clean, modular, tested, maintainable code.

• Software design skills: you can design the architecture of an end-to-end solution — services, APIs, data flows, and integrations — weigh the trade-offs, and build it to be reusable and extensible.

• Engineering practice: code review, unit and integration testing, CI/CD, and debugging in production. • Hands-on experience with at least one BI tool — Tableau, Power BI, or similar.

• A foundational understanding of statistics — enough to know when a number is meaningful and when it isn't.

• Working knowledge of dbt and BigQuery (or the ability to ramp up quickly), and everyday use of Git.

• Comfort with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude, or GitHub Copilot — we'll train you on Saras' own tooling.

• The ability to turn an ambiguous client ask into clear, testable requirements and a technical specification.

• Clear, confident client communication — you can own a delivery conversation without a go-between, run live product demos, and present to client and product stakeholders.

• The ability to work with product teams and contribute to a roadmap: you can turn customer needs and what you've built into reusable product capabilities.

**It's an even stronger fit if you also bring:**

• An engineering degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Analytics, or Data Science.

• Ecommerce data fluency: you know how contribution margin, customer cohorts, attribution, and inventory are really calculated — and where the source data misleads.

• Experience with a semantic or metrics layer, or with data-quality and observability frameworks.

• Dashboards you've built that clients actually use, and the instinct for what makes one trustworthy.

• Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow.

• Experience building APIs, integrations, or full-stack applications, and with cloud services (GCP preferred) and containerization.

• You've presented analysis directly to a client or senior stakeholder, not just to your own team.

**Location**

Hyderabad. Standard working hours are noon to 9 PM IST.

**Compensation & Benefits**

Competitive salary with performance-based bonuses, comprehensive health insurance, relocation support, and ongoing professional development. Saras Analytics is an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive workplace for all. If you want to own what gets built, end to end, on top of our product, and see it land with the client, then make it part of the product, we want to talk to you.
