title: Engineer III Software
description:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.
  
  
At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.
  
  
As we continue to scale our global platform, the Software Engineer III — Commerce Applications & Integrations will play a critical role in building and operating the applications that power our wholesale commerce experience end-to-end.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Software Engineer III — Commerce Applications & Integrations to build, operate, and continuously improve the applications that power our wholesale commerce experience — including product and catalog workflows, cart and checkout, order processing, account management, and the internal tools our operations teams rely on every day. This is a full-stack role with real end-to-end ownership spanning application development, APIs and integrations, data processing, cloud infrastructure, production support, incident resolution, security remediation, and operational readiness. The Software Engineer III — Commerce Applications & Integrations delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.
  
  
**How Will You Drive Impact**
Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)
  
  

* Partner closely with Product, Business Operations, Platform, Security, Data, and Support teams to align on technical decisions, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and ship reliable solutions collaboratively.
* Contribute to architecture discussions, modernization initiatives, and technical discovery, bringing well-reasoned perspectives on schema design, system design, and next-generation commerce capabilities.
* Participate in production support rotations and serve as a dependable technical resource for time-sensitive ordering escalations and cross-functional issue resolution.

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)
  
  

* Build and enhance wholesale commerce portal capabilities across catalog, cart, checkout, order confirmation, account, product, and user-experience workflows that customers and internal teams depend on daily.
* Support order and fulfillment business rules — including inventory availability, account configuration, ship-window and cancellation dates, and downstream order interfaces — to ensure a seamless ordering experience.
* Improve application reliability through monitoring, alerting, deployment health checks, and release validation so that customer-facing systems perform consistently and at scale.
* Participate in resolving customer access issues and account setup problems, reducing friction in the wholesale commerce experience.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)
  
  

* Design and develop scalable APIs, integrations, and supporting services using Go, Python, Node.js, and React/TypeScript that keep end-to-end business workflows reliable and extensible.
* Develop scalable data-processing solutions for product, catalog, account, and order workloads, including batch and asynchronous processing pipelines built on AWS services such as SQS/SNS, EventBridge, and Lambda.
* Contribute to application modernization efforts, including schema migration, platform refactoring, and the adoption of infrastructure-as-code practices via Terraform and GitHub Actions.
* Explore and apply emerging tools, patterns, and AI-enabled capabilities to continuously improve the quality, efficiency, and scalability of commerce systems.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)
  
  

* Take end-to-end ownership of ambiguous problems through design, implementation, testing, release, and ongoing operational support across the full commerce application stack.
* Troubleshoot production issues using structured logs, metrics, distributed traces, application behavior, and data analysis; drive root-cause analysis and implement durable fixes rather than patches.
* Address application security and software supply-chain findings — including dependency vulnerabilities, authorization gaps, CI/CD hardening, and least-privilege access — with rigor and urgency.
* Reduce recurring production issues over time by improving monitoring, operational documentation, and the underlying reliability of data and integration workflows.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY
  
  
We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:
  
  

* Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
* Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
* Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
* Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

**Required Qualifications**
CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING
  
  

* 3–6 years of professional software engineering experience with a strong track record delivering production software as an individual contributor, including full-stack ownership across frontend, backend, APIs, integrations, data, and operational concerns.
* Proficiency with React and TypeScript for building customer-facing web applications, and proficiency in at least one backend language among Go, Python, or Node.js with willingness to work across the others.
* Production experience on AWS, including compute (ECS/EKS, Lambda), storage (S3), managed databases (RDS), and messaging services (SQS/SNS, EventBridge).
* Experience designing scalable APIs, data workflows, batch and asynchronous processing pipelines, and system integrations in a production environment.
* Strong production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills using logs, metrics, traces, and data, with the ability to implement durable fixes rather than short-term patches.
* Solid understanding of secure coding practices, dependency management, authorization models, secrets handling, and CI/CD security hardening.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to work effectively alongside product, business, platform, security, and support partners on ambiguous, end-to-end problems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in wholesale commerce, order management, catalog, product, inventory, or fulfillment domains.
* Exposure to Salesforce Lightning Web Components (LWC) or the broader Salesforce commerce ecosystem.
* Experience with relational database design, query optimization, and schema migration at scale using PostgreSQL or MySQL.
* Experience with messaging and event-driven integration patterns such as Pub/Sub, SQS/SNS, Kafka, or EventBridge.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK) and GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD tooling.
* Experience with application modernization, architecture, or platform migration initiatives.

WORK LOCATION
  
  
Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located in
**Hyderabad**
, subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in-office presence IN-OFFICE SCHEDULE — Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday

**About Us**
*Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.*

description:
**Company Description**

The culture supports continuous learning, experimentation, and ownership of outcomes, making it a strong environment for engineers who enjoy working close to end users.

**Build. Deploy. Solve Real Problems.**

**We're looking for a curious, hands-on Forward Deployed Engineer**

who wants to build software that solves real-world problems and reaches production quickly.

This role is for engineers who enjoy working across the stack, getting close to how systems actually work, and turning ideas into reliable solutions. You'll work through the entire engineering lifecycle—from understanding problems and designing solutions to coding, reviewing, testing, deploying, and iterating.

You'll also work with AI-powered development tools, using them to accelerate delivery while applying your own engineering judgment to validate code, identify risks, and ensure quality.

**What You'll Do**

* **Build and ship:**

  Develop production-ready features using TypeScript and JavaScript across the stack.
* **Solve real-world problems:**

  Translate requirements and practical challenges into working software solutions.
* **Own the development lifecycle:**

  Participate in design, implementation, code review, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement.
* **Work with data:**

  Write, optimize, and troubleshoot SQL queries against real-world datasets.
* **Review code critically:**

  Evaluate human-written and AI-generated code for correctness, architecture, maintainability, performance, and security.
* **Debug systematically:**

  Investigate failures, understand error messages, trace issues to their root causes, and implement reliable fixes.
* **Collaborate and iterate:**

  Work closely with teammates to deliver solutions quickly without compromising engineering fundamentals.

**What We're Looking For**

* **TypeScript / JavaScript​:**

  Strong fundamentals, including async/await, promises, and using types to design reliable systems.
* **SQL:**

  Hands-on experience writing queries, using joins, understanding indexes, and identifying performance bottlenecks.
* **Git:**

  Comfortable with branches, commits, merge vs. rebase, reading diffs, and resolving conflicts.
* **HTTP & REST APIs:**

  Understanding of request/response flows, status codes, authentication headers, and API integration.
* **Engineering judgment:**

  Ability to test your code, verify assumptions, interpret errors, and explain why your solution works.
* **Code review mindset:**

  Willingness to challenge code including AI-generated code and identify potential architectural, delivery, and security issues.
* **Learning agility:**

  Strong fundamentals, curiosity, independent research skills, and a willingness to take ownership of unfamiliar problems.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience shipping projects in Java, Python, Go, or other programming languages.
* Familiarity with AI coding assistants and AI-driven development workflows.
* Personal projects, open-source contributions, or applications you've built and deployed.
* Experience integrating APIs, debugging production issues, or working directly with users to understand their needs.

**Who Will Thrive Here?**

* People who learn quickly, take ownership, and enjoy solving problems that don't always come with a predefined answer.
* You verify before you claim, investigate before you assume, and treat AI as a tool—not a substitute for engineering judgment.
* If you want to move beyond writing code in isolation and build solutions that work in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

We're looking for a hands-on Technical Lead / Engineering Lead who can own engineering end-to-end—from system architecture and writing production code to deployment, scaling, and production reliability.

This is not a management-only role. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys coding, solving complex technical challenges, making pragmatic architectural decisions, and building high-performing engineering teams.

You'll work closely with Product to build, launch, and scale AI-powered applications used by millions of people worldwide.

**What You'll Do**

* Own end-to-end engineering: Lead system architecture, technical design, development, deployment, scaling, and production operations.
* Stay hands-on with coding: Actively write, review, debug, and ship production code while guiding the engineering team.
* Design scalable systems: Build reliable, high-performance applications using modern backend architectures, databases, APIs, caching, queues, and asynchronous processing.
* Build AI-powered products: Integrate LLMs, generative AI models, APIs, and image, video, and audio generation workflows.
* Optimize AI infrastructure: Improve inference latency, processing performance, model integration reliability, and API costs.
* Own production reliability: Drive CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, monitoring, security, performance optimization, and incident resolution.
* Accelerate engineering delivery: Leverage AI-assisted coding tools, automation, and modern development practices to ship high-quality software faster.
* Build and mentor the team: Hire, develop, and lead engineers while establishing strong engineering standards and a culture of ownership.
* Ship products quickly: Collaborate closely with Product to turn ideas into working software, launch features rapidly, and continuously improve them.

**What We're Looking For**

* 8+ years of software engineering experience, with proven hands-on coding skills and technical leadership.
* Engineer first, leader second: Someone who enjoys writing code, solving complex technical problems, and leading by example—not just managing people.
* Strong backend or full-stack expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, React, SQL, or comparable technologies.
* Deep understanding of system architecture, distributed systems, databases, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and scalable application design.
* End-to-end product engineering experience: Proven ability to independently design, build, deploy, scale, and troubleshoot production applications.
* Practical AI/GenAI experience: Experience integrating LLM APIs and building AI-powered applications. Exposure to image, video, or audio generation is an advantage.
* Strong production engineering skills in performance optimization, security, testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and reliability.
* Experience leading and mentoring engineers, conducting code reviews, making architectural decisions, and building high-performing teams.
* AI-first development mindset: Comfortable using AI coding tools, automation, and modern engineering workflows to accelerate development.
* Strong ownership and product thinking: Able to make pragmatic technical decisions, move quickly, avoid unnecessary complexity, and deliver reliable products that create real customer value.

**Why Join Template.net?**

* Build cutting-edge AI products used by millions of people worldwide.
* Work on challenging engineering problems across generative AI, image, video, documents, and design.
* Take real ownership of technical architecture, engineering decisions, and product delivery.
* Build and lead a talented engineering team while continuing to write production code.
* Work in a fast-moving, product-focused environment where your contributions have a direct impact.

* We're looking for a builder who leads by example—someone who can take a problem, design the solution, write the code, ship it to production

title: Team Lead, Software Development - 4
description:
**Department:**
Development
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad
  
  
**Description**
We are looking for a Team Lead Software Engineer with strong software product development experience and the ability to lead feature delivery, guide engineering decisions, and support a high-performing development team. The role requires hands-on full-stack development expertise on Microsoft .NET technologies, strong understanding of cloud-native architecture, and the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders and distributed teams. The Team Lead is expected to balance individual technical contribution with people leadership, mentoring, delivery ownership, and cross-functional coordination.
  
  

* Strong product development experience and knowledge of product development processes.
* Ability to own and lead different product feature areas from requirements through release.
* Ability to work across parallel release cycles while managing team execution and delivery risks.
* Strong communication skills to interact with stakeholders, clarify requirements, and drive alignment.
* Ability to collaborate with teams across different geographical locations and time zones.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft .NET development platform and related technologies.
* Knowledge of AWS cloud services is preferred.
* Full-stack .NET development experience with interest in system integrations and data exchange techniques.
* Knowledge of ERP systems, business processes, microservices architecture, and event-driven design is preferred.
* Familiarity with security best practices including OWASP guidelines, secure coding, authentication, and authorization frameworks such as OAuth, SAML, and JWT.
* Comfortable in agile development environments with adaptability to evolving requirements and timelines.

**A Typical Day In The Life Includes**
**Engineering Delivery and Technical Execution**

* Design, develop, enhance, and maintain product features and components across the application stack.
* Translate high-level design into low-level design, implementation plans, impact analysis, and task estimates.
* Write comprehensive unit tests and support automated testing practices to improve code quality.
* Perform code walkthroughs and reviews to ensure code paths are covered, dead code is removed, and implementation aligns with specifications.
* Ensure sufficient instrumentation, logging, and diagnostics are built into the code for supportability and debugging.
* Run performance tests, optimize code, eliminate memory leaks, and improve scalability of critical workflows.
* Assist in CI/CD pipeline activities and ensure product builds are stable and release-ready.
* Debug and fix defects identified during development, testing, production support, and customer issue investigation.
* Partner with Support teams on issue diagnosis, root-cause analysis, workaround identification, and permanent resolution.

**Team Management and People Leadership**

* Provide day-to-day technical direction to engineers, helping the team prioritize work, remove blockers, and maintain steady delivery progress.
* Support sprint planning, backlog refinement, task breakdown, and execution tracking in collaboration with the manager, product owner, and scrum team.
* Monitor development progress, identify delivery risks early, and escalate issues with clear context, options, and recommendations.
* Promote engineering discipline across the team by encouraging strong design reviews, code quality, test coverage, documentation, and operational readiness.
* Create an inclusive and collaborative team environment where engineers can ask questions, share knowledge, and contribute effectively.
* Help onboard new team members by explaining product architecture, development practices, release processes, and domain context.

**Technical Leadership and Architecture**

* Lead technical discussions for assigned feature areas, including architecture choices, integration patterns, API contracts, data flow, security considerations, and scalability needs.
* Guide the team in applying design patterns, microservices principles, event-driven design, secure coding practices, and cloud-native engineering standards.
* Evaluate technical trade-offs and recommend pragmatic solutions that balance maintainability, performance, security, timelines, and business priorities.
* Own quality gates for assigned modules, including design completeness, code review readiness, testability, observability, deployment readiness, and support handover.
* Drive technical debt identification and remediation plans while ensuring ongoing feature delivery is not compromised.
* Stay hands-on with development and troubleshooting, especially in complex, high-risk, or cross-component areas.

**Mentoring and Capability Building**

* Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, debugging sessions, and structured knowledge-sharing discussions.
* Help junior and mid-level engineers improve estimation, problem decomposition, coding standards, testing habits, and ownership mindset.
* Encourage reuse of common components, shared engineering practices, and consistent documentation across the team.
* Provide timely, constructive technical feedback to help team members improve delivery quality and engineering maturity.
* Identify skill gaps and recommend learning opportunities related to .NET, AWS cloud services, integrations, security, performance, and AI-enabled product capabilities.

**Project Ownership and Delivery Accountability**

* Own end-to-end delivery of assigned initiatives, features, or technical workstreams from requirements clarification through design, build, testing, release, and post-release support.
* Ensure scope, dependencies, assumptions, risks, and acceptance criteria are understood before implementation starts.
* Coordinate with QA, DevOps, Support, Product Management, Architecture, Security, and dependent engineering teams to ensure smooth delivery.
* Track commitments, communicate progress periodically, and ensure stakeholders have visibility into status, risks, and mitigation plans.
* Support release readiness activities, including build validation, deployment checks, defect triage, production monitoring, and rollback or recovery planning where applicable.
* Drive root-cause analysis for recurring defects or production issues and convert findings into preventive engineering improvements.

**Stakeholder Management and Communication**

* Engage with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, support teams, and cross-functional engineering teams to clarify requirements and align on implementation approach.
* Communicate technical decisions, risks, trade-offs, and delivery status clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Represent the engineering team in design discussions, sprint ceremonies, release discussions, issue triage, and customer-impact analysis as required.
* Escalate deviations from specifications, design assumptions, UI mockups, timelines, or quality expectations with proposed resolution options.
* Ensure team documentation, design notes, release notes, and support handover information are accurate and maintained.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Hands-on Microsoft .NET development experience, including C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core, Web API, web services, and related frameworks.
* Experience with SQL Server, XML standards, JavaScript/JQuery, API integration, and service-based application development.
* Good understanding of design patterns, SOLID principles, clean code practices, and maintainable application architecture.
* Experience with Git-based configuration management and modern development workflows.
* Good understanding of AWS cloud technologies such as Lambda, Step Functions, SQS, Textract, Bedrock, and related cloud services.
* Experience with microservices architecture, event-driven systems, distributed processing, performance optimization, scalability, and observability.
* Good understanding of Python and machine learning concepts is preferred.
* Good to have experience with Generative AI technologies, including frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Hugging Face, and integration of AI/ML models into software applications.
* Knowledge of ERP systems, document processing, system integrations, and business workflows is preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications**
**Leadership Expectations**

* Ownership mindset: Takes accountability for outcomes, not just assigned tasks, and follows through until issues are resolved.
* Execution discipline: Balances technical quality with delivery timelines and keeps the team focused on priorities.
* Decision quality: Makes practical engineering decisions using data, technical judgment, and stakeholder context.
* Coaching orientation: Invests time in mentoring team members and raising overall team capability.
* Collaboration: Works effectively across functions, locations, and release cycles while maintaining transparency.
* Operational readiness: Ensures features are supportable, observable, secure, scalable, and production-ready.
* Continuous improvement: Identifies recurring problems and drives improvements in process, architecture, automation, and engineering practices.

**To Be Successful You Need**

* Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum of 4 years of software development experience, with demonstrated ability to lead feature areas or technical workstreams.
* Strong hands-on technical capability with Microsoft .NET, cloud services, APIs, integrations, and modern engineering practices.
* Good communication skills and ability to work with multiple teams, geographies, and stakeholder groups.
* Proven ability to mentor engineers, review designs, guide implementation, and improve technical quality.
* Good team player with a collaborative approach and willingness to support team members during critical delivery or production issues.
* Ability to manage ambiguity, clarify requirements, break down complex work, and drive execution in agile environments.
* Strong customer and product mindset, with focus on quality, maintainability, performance, security, and supportability.

**Success Measures**

* Feature work is delivered with clear ownership, predictable execution, and minimal avoidable rework.
* Code quality, test coverage, documentation, observability, and support readiness improve across assigned areas.
* Team members receive timely guidance, blockers are addressed quickly, and engineering practices become more consistent.
* Stakeholders receive clear communication on progress, risks, dependencies, and technical trade-offs.
* Production issues, recurring defects, and technical debt are actively analyzed and converted into improvement actions.

**Deliver for our customers**

**Grow our people**

* Mentor and guide other engineers through design reviews, coding standards, problem solving, and day to day technical leadership.
* Share knowledge, encourage strong engineering habits, and help raise the technical capability of the team over time.
* Lead through influence, collaboration, and a willingness to make others around you stronger.

**What We Are Looking For**

* A strong AI mindset and a proven track record of using AI tools to improve productivity, accelerate delivery, strengthen engineering quality, and simplify day to day work.

* A genuine interest in mentoring others, sharing knowledge, and helping raise the technical capability of the team over time.
* A positive, collaborative attitude and the ability to translate technical concepts into clear, easy to understand language.

**Job Description Summary**
If you’re enthusiastic about delivering secure technology solutions to support a company providing extraordinary care to its customers, then Nationwide Technology is the place for you. Nationwide's industry-leading technology workforce embraces an agile work environment and a collaborative culture to deliver outstanding solutions and results. If that sounds like something you aspire to, we want to hear from you!
  
  
As a Tech Lead, you will focus on mentoring and leading others to deliver high-quality, cost-effective technology solutions by providing technical leadership, setting engineering direction and creating clear accountability for product and application health across delivery teams. You will translate business goals into technical strategy, strengthen engineering quality, manage technical debt and operational risk, and improve continuity and coordination across teams while remaining grounded in firsthand engineering practices. You’ll also guide the evaluation and practical use of emerging technologies to improve delivery effectiveness, resiliency, and long-term product sustainability.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provides technical direction and leadership for product development and oversees architecture and design decisions to support scalability, performance and long-term product health.
* Responsible for applying secure software and systems engineering practices throughout the delivery lifecycle to ensure data and technology solutions are protected from threats and vulnerabilities.
* Mentors and trains team members on design techniques, tools, coding standards and engineering best practices.
* Provides strategic advice on using technology to achieve business and product goals and helps align product development with customer needs and desired outcomes.
* Translates product and business priorities into technical strategy, solution direction and execution guardrails for the team.
* Maintains end-to-end technical ownership for assigned products or applications and drives accountability for architecture, engineering execution, operational health and long-term sustainability.
* Applies a product mindset by aligning technical strategy, sequencing and tradeoff decisions to long-term product roadmaps, customer needs and business outcomes.
* Strengthens knowledge continuity by building institutional knowledge, promoting documentation and developing technical backup depth to reduce key-person dependency.
* Establishes accountability for application quality and technical health by driving visibility and action around code quality, testing, technical debt, vulnerabilities, currency and release readiness.
* Drives cross-collaboration and execution across multiple teams, including coordination with architects, Tech Consultants, Distinguished Engineers, product owners and the broader developer community.
* Partners with product, delivery and agile leaders to plan timelines, manage resource needs, track quarterly commitments and mitigate risks throughout the product lifecycle.
* Leads the team in implementing new features and enhancements and ensures timely delivery of high-quality software products.
* Establishes and reinforces robust software engineering practices, including code reviews, automated testing, consistent sprint execution and prompt resolution of technical issues and defects.
* Champions the use of DevSecOps practices, tooling and techniques and ensures continuous learning and improvement through ongoing training, practice and innovation.
* Establishes and reinforces engineering guardrails by ensuring design decisions, code changes, test approaches and production readiness align with security, quality, resiliency and supportability expectations.
* Evaluates and guides the practical use of emerging technologies, automation patterns and modern engineering approaches to improve delivery outcomes without weakening accountability or engineering discipline.
* Helps create clear technical ownership for applications, strengthens knowledge continuity and supports better management of technical debt, vulnerabilities, currency and release readiness, including empowered go/no-go input when appropriate.

**Education**

**Experience**

Firsthand technical leadership experience leading project teams and setting technical direction. Deep expertise in one programming language such as Java, C++, Python, JavaScript. title: Product Engineer
description:
**About the role:**

We are building internal products that change how enterprise implementation work gets done. The products are live, in daily use, and growing. We are hiring experienced product engineers to build on them. This is a hands-on engineering role. You will pick up items from a live backlog, design the solution, build it, prove it works and ship it. The work spans the full stack, from data and services through to the screens people use. It suits an engineer who is comfortable owning something end to end, works well with an incomplete brief, and enjoys building tools that other professionals rely on to do their job.

**Job Location:**
Hyderabad, Bhubaneswar, Kolkata, Noida

**What you will be doing:**

•
**Delivering from the backlog.**
Items are raised continuously as the products are used and as new capability is needed. You take them, size them, build them and see them through to production.

•
**Building across the stack.**
Services, data model, integrations and user interface. You own the change from end to end rather than handing it across a boundary.

•
**Working with structured and unstructured data.**
Reading, transforming and validating data from documents, spreadsheets, exports and APIs, where the input is real and rarely clean.

•
**Integrating with enterprise platforms.**
Authenticating, reading and writing to business systems through their APIs, and handling the realities of rate limits, failures and partial results.

•
**Applying AI where it earns its place.**
Large language models are part of how these products work. You will build with them, measure them, and know when a deterministic approach is the better engineering answer.

•
**Proving the work.**
Automated tests, verified behaviour, and a release you can explain. Quality is part of delivery here, not a separate phase.

•
**Shaping what gets built.**
You will have direct input into priorities and approach. Experienced engineers here are expected to have opinions and argue them.

**Skills and experience**

**Commercial experience**
: 8+ years building and shipping production software, with meaningful time at senior level.

**Core languages:**
Strong TypeScript and JavaScript across back end and front end. Python or C# as a secondary language is welcome.

**Back end:**
Modern Node.js, API design, authentication, validation and error handling in a service you have run in production.

**Front end:**
React with modern patterns: function components, hooks, client-side data fetching and state. Clean, usable interfaces without a designer holding your hand.

**Data:**
Strong relational database skills. Schema design, real SQL, transactions, indexing and migrations. Comfortable modelling tables, columns, keys and relationships from a messy business problem.

**Data formats**
: Confident with JSON, XML, XPath and query languages, spreadsheet formats and document parsing. You can work with a schema you did not design and cannot change.

**Cloud:**
Building and running services in a major cloud, ideally Azure. Identity, secrets management, deployment and monitoring.

**AI engineering:**
Practical experience building with large language models: prompt design, structured output, validating what comes back, cost and latency as measured numbers.

**Engineering practice:**
Automated testing as a habit, version control discipline, and code that the next person can maintain.

***Highly regarded***

• Working knowledge of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 ecosystem and the Power Platform

• Familiarity with other enterprise business platforms such as NetSuite, SAP or Salesforce

• Experience with enterprise integration patterns and middleware

• Document intelligence, information extraction or natural language processing

• Reporting and analytics platforms

• Background in professional services or consulting, so you understand the people the products serve

title: SAP Consultants - Lead
description:
**What you will do on your journey with WebBeds.**

As an SAP Consultant Lead / SAP ABAP Developer Lead, you will join the growing global SAP team at WebBeds and play a key role in our SAP S/4HANA and RISE with SAP transformation journey.

**\***
These roles are based in Hyderabad and can also be considered in Bangalore, Pune, Chennai or Noida. We are building an internal SAP capability to drive innovation, reduce reliance on external partners and establish long-term ownership of our business processes and SAP solutions.'

We are recruiting across multiple functional and technical domains, with opportunities for SAP R2R, O2C, P2P & FP&A, together with an SAP ABAP Developer Lead.

Each successful candidate will lead delivery and solution ownership within their area of expertise. Functional Leads will collaborate with Finance, Procurement, Commercial and Operations teams to translate business requirements into scalable SAP solutions, while the SAP ABAP Developer Lead will partner with Functional Leads, Global Process Owners and technical teams to deliver Clean Core-aligned developments, integrations, analytics and automation.

All roles will contribute to process standardisation, innovation, compliance, operational excellence and measurable business value.

**In this role you will:**

**Key responsibilities**

* **End-to-end delivery:**
  lead delivery within your assigned functional domain or ABAP technical specialism, from requirements and solution design through testing, deployment, go-live, hypercare and operational handover.
* **Stakeholder partnership:**
  partner with business stakeholders, Global Process Owners, SAP teams, integration teams and delivery partners to define scalable future-state solutions.
* **SAP best practice:**
  champion SAP S/4HANA best practices, RISE with SAP, fit-to-standard delivery and Clean Core principles.
* **Design, testing and deployment:**
  lead or support workshops, fit-gap analysis, solution design, documentation, SIT, UAT, end-to-end testing, data migration, cutover and production readiness.
* **Automation and governance:**
  drive automation, process standardisation, continuous improvement, controls, compliance and governance.
* **Innovation:**
  identify opportunities to apply SAP Signavio, SAP Business AI, Joule, SAP BTP, SAP Build, Datasphere, SAC, Cloud ALM and LeanIX where relevant to your role (nice to have).
* **Specialist leadership:**
  provide leadership within your specialist area through design assurance, quality oversight, knowledge transfer and effective collaboration with internal and external teams.
* **Record-to-Report (R2R) Functional Consultant Lead:**
  own end-to-end R2R processes within SAP S/4HANA, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Intercompany Accounting, Tax, Financial Close, Statutory and Management Reporting, Profitability Analysis (CO-PA), Bank Reconciliations and Finance Controls, and partner with O2C and P2P process owners to support an integrated Finance operating model across the WebBeds SAP landscape.
* **Order-to-Cash (O2C) Functional Consultant Lead:**
  own end-to-end O2C processes within SAP S/4HANA, including Customer Master Data, Sales Order Management, Pricing, Billing and Invoicing, Accounts Receivable, Credit Management, Collections, Dispute Management, Cash Application, Revenue Management and customer experience optimisation, and lead the design, configuration, standardisation and continuous improvement of SAP SD and FSCM capabilities to strengthen revenue assurance, working capital, collections effectiveness and operational efficiency.
* **Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Functional Consultant Lead:**
  own end-to-end P2P processes within SAP S/4HANA, including Supplier Master Data and Onboarding, Sourcing and Contracts, Requisitions, Purchase Orders, Goods and Service Receipts, Invoice Verification, Supplier Reconciliations, Payment Integration, Spend Visibility, Procurement Compliance, Supplier Performance, and SAP MM procurement and inventory management.
* **Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) Functional Consultant Lead:**
  own planning and performance management processes, including budgeting, rolling forecasts, scenario modelling, cost and profit centre planning, allocations, profitability analysis, business performance analysis, management reporting, dashboards, planning standardisation, SAC Planning, Datasphere and decision-support insights.
* **SAP ABAP Developer Lead:**
  own the technical design and delivery of SAP ABAP and BTP solutions across R2R, O2C, P2P & FP&A, translating functional requirements into scalable RICEFW objects, custom transactions, reports, interfaces, forms, workflows, CDS-based data models, APIs, integrations, Fiori services and intelligent automation solutions aligned with Clean Core principles.

**The skills we would love to see in your suitcase!**

* Proven experience in at least one of the functional domains (R2R, O2C, P2P, FP&A) or in SAP ABAP development, with relevant professional experience, technical expertise and business process knowledge.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, strong hands-on SAP ABAP experience in S/4HANA, including ABAP Objects, Data Dictionary, ALV, Smart Forms or Adobe Forms, enhancements, BAdIs, user exits and performance optimisation.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, experience developing across SAP FI, CO, MM and SD business processes, with the ability to understand functional specifications and intended business outcomes.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, integration experience using IDocs, BAPIs, APIs, SAP Integration Suite or equivalent SAP integration technologies.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, advanced experience with ABAP CDS Views, including data models, analytical queries and consumption views supporting Fiori, Datasphere, SAC and Finance reporting.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, experience with RAP, OData services, APIs, SAP Gateway, Fiori/UI5 extensibility and SAP BTP or side-by-side extension patterns.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, exposure to SAP Business AI, Joule, SAP Build, AI-assisted development, workflow automation or agentic automation is strongly preferred (nice to have).
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, the ability to lead technical design, code reviews, development standards, documentation, testing, transport governance, defect resolution and developer mentoring.
* Please apply for the role that best aligns with your experience and state clearly in your application which role or domain best matches your background, demonstrating relevant depth in that area.
* Applications will be assessed against the requirements of the selected functional domain or SAP ABAP technical role.

title: Architect, Apps & AI

The Architect is a senior leader responsible for the successful technical execution and delivery of complex client projects across diverse domains. In the AI-first GCID organization, Architect(s) are expected to embed AI-native thinking into delivery models, ensuring solutions are intelligent, scalable, and aligned with business outcomes. The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, demonstrates breadth of expertise, and advocates for solutions that deliver true client value.

Lead cross-functional teams, promote learning and collaboration, and uphold technical standards. Review work, offer feedback, and support team growth.

Ensure secure, compliant, and reliable solution delivery through secure coding, test‑driven development, observability, design reviews, and quality gates across all engagements.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* 16+ years of experience in software/solution engineering, with at least 8-12 years as Architect and delivery leadership roles.

* Strong understanding of modern delivery methodologies (Agile, Scrum, DevOps, etc.).
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and team leadership skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

**Areas of Expertise**
**Full Stack Application Engineering**




+ End-to-end design and development of modern web and mobile applications using React, Angular, Next.js, Blazor, or equivalent frameworks
+ Strong backend expertise using .NET / Java / Node.js / Python, with clean architecture, domain-driven design, and API-first principles
+ Experience building microservices and distributed systems using REST, gRPC, event-driven patterns, and asynchronous processing
+ Hands-on expertise with relational and NoSQL databases (Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB) and performance tuning
+ Strong understanding of state management, scalability, resiliency, and application security

**AI Driven Application Development**

* Proven expertise in AI‑driven application development, embedding intelligence directly into modern, cloud‑native applications.
* Extensive hands‑on experience using GitHub Copilot as a core engineering capability to accelerate solution design, coding, refactoring, testing, and documentation across delivery teams.
* Demonstrated ability to foster a Copilot‑assisted engineering culture (“vibe”) - enabling rapid iteration, AI pair‑programming, explain‑as‑you‑build workflows, and high‑velocity delivery without compromising engineering quality.
* Strong experience modernizing application landscapes using GitHub Copilot‑assisted approaches, including rapid codebase comprehension, dependency analysis, large‑scale refactoring, and migration to cloud‑native and AI‑enabled architectures.
* Effective use of GitHub Copilot across the entire SDLC, from solutioning and scaffolding through CI/CD automation, test generation, production readiness, and operational excellence.
* Ability to coach and enable teams and customers on effective Copilot usage patterns, prompt strategies, and safe AI‑assisted engineering practices in enterprise environments.
* Apply Responsible AI principles across design and delivery, incorporating security, privacy, governance, and compliance controls into production‑grade engineering workflows.

**AI-Enabled Application Development**

* Ability to translate business scenarios into production‑grade AI solutions using Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services, Azure AI Foundry, and custom ML models, with hands‑on delivery of RAG architectures leveraging Azure AI Search, vector databases, enterprise data grounding, and integration patterns.

+ Experience in cost‑aware architecture design, applying cost optimization strategies such as right‑sizing, autoscaling, consumption‑based services, and proactive cost governance.

**DevOps, Platform & Developer Productivity**




+ Strong expertise in designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions, enabling automated build, test, security scanning, and deployment workflows across environments.
+ Proven hands‑on experience with Infrastructure‑as‑Code (IaC) using Bicep, ARM, and Terraform, leveraging GitHub Copilot to scaffold modules, generate templates, and propose secure configurations aligned with enterprise standards.
+ Deep understanding of observability and reliability engineering, including centralized logging, metrics, distributed tracing, SLOs, and proactive alerting for production systems.
+ Demonstrated ability to enhance developer productivity and delivery velocity through inner‑source practices, reusable components, reference implementations, accelerators, and automation.
+ Experience embedding DevSecOps practices into delivery pipelines, including secure coding checks, dependency scanning, secrets management, policy enforcement, and compliance validation.
+ Effective use of GitHub Copilot across the DevOps lifecycle, including authoring pipeline definitions, generating runbooks and release notes, assisting with PR summaries, and accelerating troubleshooting and incident response.
+ Strong grasp of platform engineering principles, building paved‑road solutions and self‑service capabilities that balance speed, governance, and operational excellence.
+ Ability to continuously improve engineering throughput, quality, and system reliability, while maintaining enterprise security and compliance expectations.

**Solutioning, Pre-Sales & Technical Leadership**




+ Lead technical solutioning, estimations, and support architecture design during pre-sales and delivery shaping
+ Translate business outcomes into clear architecture, execution plans, and risk mitigation strategies
+ Influence technical direction across multiple teams and engagements
+ Act as a trusted advisor to clients and internal leadership

**Frontier Engineering & Customer Enablement Skills**




+ Lead rapid prototyping, pilots, and early-stage deployments for enterprise customers
+ Ability to go from whiteboard to production with minimal friction
+ Strong troubleshooting and production support expertise, including performance, reliability, and security issues
+ Side‑by‑side coding with customer engineering teams to unblock deployments and accelerate time to value
+ Outcome‑driven engineering focused on business impact, not activity
+ Building reusable assets, accelerators, and reference implementations

**Personal Attributes**

* Passion for technology and innovation.
* Ability to interact confidently with senior leaders and clients.

description:
**Job Description**
The Core Engineering
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The Core Engineering builds and operates the platforms, applications, data solutions, models, and analytics that power critical processes for The Core divisions of the firm (e.g., Risk, responsible for the risk profile of firm activities; Controllers, responsible for the financial control and reporting obligations; Compliance, responsible for the firm’s compliance, regulatory, and reputational risks; Corporate Treasury, responsible for the firm’s liquidity, funding, balance sheet, etc.; and Human Capital Management, responsible for attracting, developing, and managing a global workforce). A centralized engineering structure in support of The Core enables a common platform model and operating framework that promotes consistent governance and scalable solutions, leveraging cloud, AI, and machine learning for innovation and efficiency. The Core Engineering’s 2,000+ engineers and strats deliver engineering, data, analytics, and quantitative capabilities within six business units:
  
  

* Metrics & Analytics Platforms: responsible for the measurement and management of the firm’s risk, capital, and liquidity for The Core functions
* The Core Strats: responsible for the development and implementation of models and other quantitative methodologies, including the accuracy and attribution of modeled metrics
* Financials & Reporting: responsible for facilitating the production of the firm’s financials and a wide range of reporting functions
* Non-Financial Risk & Controls: responsible for non-financial risk and control processes
* Enterprise Platforms: responsible for platforms and applications that support critical operational processes across The Core such as payments, people processes, and procurement
* Shared Services: responsible for driving the adoption of consistent engineering strategy, including data platforms, cloud, and AI enablement, as well as the management of technology risk

**YOUR IMPACT**
Are you passionate about leveraging cutting-edge AI/ML techniques, including Large Language Models, to solve complex, mission-critical problems in a dynamic environment? Do you want to contribute to safeguarding a leading global financial institution?
  
  
**OUR IMPACT**
We are Compliance Engineering, a global team of engineers and scientists dedicated to preventing, detecting, and mitigating regulatory and reputational risks across Goldman Sachs. We build and operate a suite of platforms and applications that protect the firm and its clients.
  
  
**We Offer**

* Access to petabyte scale of structured and unstructured data to fuel your AI/ML models, including textual data suitable for LLM applications.
* The opportunity to work with state-of-the-art LLM models and agentic framework.
* A collaborative environment where you can learn from and contribute to a team of experienced engineers and scientists.
* The chance to make a tangible impact on the firm's ability to manage risk and maintain its reputation.

Within Compliance Engineering, we are seeking an experienced AI/ML Engineer to join our Engineering team. This role will focus on solving highly complex business problems using AI/ML techniques, incorporating latest emerging trends om building out vertical AI agents to run on data at massive scale.
  
  
**How You Will Fulfill Your Potential**
As a member of our team, you will:
  
  

* Design, develop, and implement GenAI-driven solutions, including agentic frameworks for automating compliance processes, RAG pipelines, and embeddings of compliance knowledge bases.
* Explore diverse AI/ML problems, such as model fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and experimentation with different algorithmic approaches to address novel business challenges.
* Develop, test, and maintain high-quality, production-ready code.
* Collaborate effectively with compliance officers, legal counsel, and other stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, maintainability, and adherence to coding standards. Promote best practices for AI/ML development, including version control, testing, and documentation.
* Stay current with the latest advancements in AI/ML platforms, tools, and techniques to solve business problems.

**Qualifications**
A successful candidate will possess the following attributes:
  
  

* A Bachelor's, master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, or a similar field of study.
* Preferably 3+ years AI/ML industry experience for Bachelor’s/Masters, 1 year for PhD with a focus on Language Models.
* Strong foundation in machine learning algorithms, including deep learning architectures (e.g., transformers, RNNs, CNNs)
* Proficiency in Python and relevant libraries/frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, scikit-learn.
* Demonstrated expertise in GenAI techniques, including but not limited to Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), model fine-tuning, prompt engineering, AI agents, and evaluation techniques.
* Experience working with embedding models and vector databases.
* Experience with MLOps practices, including model deployment, containerization (Docker, kubernetes), CI/CD, and model monitoring.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Curiosity, ownership and willingness to work in a collaborative environment.

Experience in some of the following is desired and can set you apart from other candidates:
  
  

* Experience with Agentic Frameworks (e.g., Langchain, AutoGen) and their application to real-world problems.
* Understanding of scalability and performance optimization techniques for real-time inference such as quantization, pruning, and knowledge distillation.
* Experience with model interpretability techniques.
* Prior experience in code reviews/ architecture design for distributed systems.
* Experience with data governance and data quality principles.
* Familiarity with financial regulations and compliance requirements.

At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. title: Senior Software Engineer - Full Stack
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack Developer) to design, build, and maintain scalable web applications across the front end, back end, and cloud infrastructure. This role requires a strong foundation in modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks, Python and Node.js backend development, containerized microservices, and hands-on experience deploying and operating applications on AWS. The ideal candidate is comfortable owning features end-to-end — from UI implementation to API design to cloud deployment — and collaborates effectively within an Agile team.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain full stack web applications spanning front-end, back-end, and cloud environments
* Develop and integrate REST/SOAP APIs and microservices to support business applications and AI-driven workflows
* Enhance, troubleshoot, and support existing production applications, ensuring reliability, performance, and scalability
* Deploy and manage applications on AWS using containerized (Docker/ECS Fargate) and serverless (Lambda/API Gateway) architectures
* Collaborate with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers within an Agile development process
* Participate in code reviews and apply static code analysis and security scanning tools to maintain code quality
* Collaborate with IT partners, business teams, and the broader IT matrix organization to understand requirements and use cases, support solution design and delivery of new digital capabilities, and contribute to the enablement and simplification of existing ones — translating requirements into user stories, epics, and sprint-ready tasks using Agile/Scrum methodologies
* Gather requirements, propose solution options, and communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders

**Desired Experience**
**Front End**

* Strong hands-on experience building production applications with ReactJS (with TypeScript); working knowledge of Next.js
* Experience with React Native for mobile development
* Exposure to an additional front-end framework such as Vue.js is a plus
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), HTML, and CSS
* Experience with modern CSS frameworks/libraries such as Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, and component libraries like shadcn/ui

**Back End**

* Solid experience with Python and Node.js for building server-side applications and services
* Experience designing and building REST APIs; familiarity with SOAP APIs
* Hands-on experience with microservices architecture and Docker containerization
* Experience with backend frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, Django, and Express.js
* Understanding of ORM concepts and implementation

**Database**

* Experience with PostgreSQL and DynamoDB (or similar relational and NoSQL databases)
* Familiarity with SQLite for lightweight/local data storage use cases
* Practical experience with data modeling for both relational and NoSQL systems

**Cloud (AWS)**

* Hands-on experience with core AWS services API Gateway, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, Route 53, EC2, ECR, ECS Fargate, ALB, NLB, and IAM
* Understanding of serverless and containerized deployment patterns on AWS
* Working knowledge of AWS security and access management (IAM roles/policies)

**DevOps**

* Proficient with Git for version control and collaborative development workflows
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code using CloudFormation
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and/or AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild, and CodeDeploy
* Familiarity with static code analysis and linting tools such as PyLint and ESLint

**Tools & Collaboration**

* Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code and GitHub Copilot within VS Code
* Experience working with JIRA and Confluence in an Agile development environment
* Strong track record of participating in code reviews and applying static code analysis tools such as SonarQube and Snyk Code

**Good to Have**

* Exposure to Generative AI and Agentic AI concepts and application development
* Experience with LangChain and/or LangGraph for building AI-driven workflows and agents
* Familiarity with Azure OpenAI and/or AWS Bedrock
* Understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and its use in AI tool integrations

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
* 4–7 years of professional software development experience, with demonstrated full stack project delivery
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a cross-functional Agile team
* Solid understanding of software engineering best practices, including version control, code review, testing, and secure coding standards
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Demonstrated experience deploying and supporting applications in a cloud environment (AWS preferred)

We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.
  
  
**How We Work**
Where you work matters – because collaboration, innovation and patient impact happen in many settings. Our roles are structured across four work models site-essential, site-by-design, field-based and remote-by-design. The model assigned to this role is based on its core responsibilities. Learn more at https //careers.bms.com/ways-of-working.

Applicants can request a reasonable workplace accommodation/adjustment prior to accepting a job offer. If you require reasonable accommodations/adjustments in completing this application, or in any part of the recruitment process, direct your inquiries to adastaffingsupport@bms.com. Visit careers.bms.com/eeo-accessibility to access our complete Equal Employment Opportunity statement.

More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology.
  
  
**Job Description**
Job Summary\*\*
  
  
**Get To Know Us:**
  
  
SS&C GIDS provides information processing and computer software services and products.  The Company’s operating segments include financial markets, customer management, professional services, and output solutions.  SS&C GIDS serves the alternative investments, asset and wealth management, banking and lending, insurance, and real estate industries.

title: Senior Principal Engineer
company: Prodigy Systems and Services Private Limited`
description:
**Job Details**

* **Location:**
  Hyderabad, India (
  **100% Work from Office**
  )
* **Experience Required:**
  12–15 Years
* **Job Type:**
  Full-Time / Permanent
* **Client Context:**
  US-Based Fortune 200 Energy & Utilities Enterprise
* **Travel Requirement:**
  Active
  **US Business Visa (B1/B2)**
  required for potential immediate travel deployment

**About Us: The Prodigy DNA**

**At Prodigy Systems and Services**
, we are an
**AI-Native, extensive-engineering-focused enterprise**
that believes software engineering is an elite craft. For over
**14 years**
, we have maintained a deeply trusted, bulletproof foothold with our primary US Fortune 200 client. Today, we have a powerhouse family of
**70 elite engineers**
actively scaling and supporting their infrastructure.

We are a tight-knit family of professionals built on a core pillar of deep mutual respect. Our strengths are anchored in
**Customer First, Integrity, Transparency, and Innovation**
. We are working hungry, driven to make a true difference in society and the world through hyper-velocity technological progress.

When you join Prodigy, you will experience:

* **Warm, brilliant colleagues**
  who push you to be your best engineering self.
* **A humble management team**
  that is fiercely committed to doing the right thing.
* **An environment of radical documentation:**
  We live by a strict operational doctrine:
  **"Over-communication is a mandatory requirement."**
  We heavily utilize Microsoft Teams, Emails, and written technical specs.
  **If it is not in writing, it never happened.**

**Role Description & Intent**

**We are looking for a powerhouse, battle-tested Senior Consultant / Principal Engineer (IC)**
who can single-handedly pull the engineering weight of an entire team. This is a high-throttle street—the work is highly demanding, intensely fast-paced, yet deeply rewarding.

This is strictly a
**production-code-producing role**
. You will not be limited to high-level whiteboard architecture; you must actively write, optimize, compile, and ship the code you design. You will be responsible for tearing down a legacy enterprise stack and rebuilding it from scratch using state-of-the-art Generative AI acceleration.

**Core Responsibilities & Technical Expectations**

* **Production Code Execution:**
  Massively produce clean, scalable, production-grade code leveraging
  **Microsoft .NET Core (C#)**
  and advanced
  **SQL Server**
  engineering.
* **AI-Autonomous Engineering:**
  Operate as an AI-augmented developer. You must natively orchestrate autonomous AI software agents (like
  **Devin**
  ) and advanced tools (
  **ChatGPT, Cursor, Windsurf**
  ) within sandboxed environments to multiply development speed.
* **Spec-Driven Development (SDD):**
  Write software exclusively against rigorous, unambiguous technical specifications. Code is only written once the spec is perfect.
* **Architectural Rigor:**
  Strictly apply
  **SOLID principles**
  and decoupled design patterns to ensure the new stack is easily maintainable.
* **High-Scale Engineering:**
  Design, implement, and maintain systems built to handle
  **0.5 Million+ active customers**
  and scale smoothly through
  **5 Million+ transactions daily**
  with bulletproof stability.
* **Hybrid Infrastructure Management:**
  Engineer code optimized to run seamlessly within a primary
  **On-Premises Data Center**
  while managing low-latency replication and automated failover pipelines to
  **AWS Disaster Recovery (DR)**
  .
* **Observability & Instrumentation:**
  Build world-class distributed log instrumentation and tracing setups to ensure zero blind spots across the On-Prem/AWS boundary.
* **Cost-Sensitive Engineering:**
  Demonstrate a relentless focus on minimizing cloud operational spend, compute overhead, and execution costs per transaction.

**Core Skills & Competencies**

* **Primary Stack:**
  Microsoft .NET C#, .NET Core, Advanced SQL Server (Query optimization, locking, indexing structures).
* **AI Engineering:**
  Cognition Devin orchestration, ChatGPT prompt engineering, Cursor, Windsurf.
* **Methodologies:**
  Spec-Driven Development (SDD), SOLID Principles, Test-Driven Development (TDD).
* **Infrastructure:**
  Hybrid Data Centers, AWS Core Services (EC2, S3, RDS, DR automation).
* **Observability:**
  Advanced Distributed Logging, Telemetry, and APM Instrumentation.
* **Industry Knowledge:**
  Prior experience in the
  **Texas Energy & Utilities sector**
  (ERCOT, smart grids, or deregulated market clearing) is a massive plus.

**Rigorous 4-Round Interview Evaluation Process**

1. **Round 1: Elite Core Engineering & Architecture Deep-Dive**

* *Focus:*
  Severe testing of .NET/C# memory allocations, asynchronous programming models, multi-threading, and SQL Server transactional plan internals.

1. **Round 2: The AI-Augmented Hyper-Velocity Coding Challenge**

* *Focus:*
  A live, 60-minute, hands-on programming test. Candidates must leverage Generative AI tools (Devin/Cursor paradigms) to modernize a complex legacy code block into fully instrumented, spec-driven code.

1. **Round 3: Scale, Hybrid Infra & Cost-Sensitive Systems Design**

* *Focus:*
  Whiteboard scenario cracking. Designing for 5M daily transactions, maintaining sync across On-Prem and AWS DR, and proving compute-cost efficiency.

1. **Round 4: High-Throttle Executive & Cultural Fit**

* *Focus:*
  Evaluation of written and verbal communication fluency, mental stamina under high pressure.

title: Specialist - Software Development & Engineering- JAVA
description:
Your opportunity
  
  
At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
  
  
Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region.
  
  
We are seeking a highly skilled Java Developer to build and maintain secure Java based systems that support our critical business functions. The ideal candidate delivers high quality, efficient, and testable code while adhering to established architectural standards. This role is well suited for someone who demonstrates strong technical expertise, a commitment to continuous improvement with AI tools, and the ability to collaborate across teams.
  
  
What you have
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* 2-4 years of work experience or bachelor’s degree with 2+ years' experience
* 2 years of Application development experience with J2EE (Java 17 preferred), Spring framework (Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Batch), Splunk/DataDog
* Experience with SQL/NoSQL (Oracle, MongoDB 5.0 etc.)
* Understanding of RESTful APIs, distributed systems, and integration patterns (RabbitMQ, KAFKA)
* Experience with Unit Testing Framework (Junit)
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Knowledge of Agile methodology and experience in a Scaled Agile environment
* Understands security, scaling, performance, and availability concerns.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively and communicate technical concepts clearly.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with cloud native development, or containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with continuous build process using GitHub Actions, Bamboo, Jenkins
* Familiarity with performance engineering, monitoring, and related tooling (e.g., AppDynamics, Splunk, Grafana, PCF metrics).
* Experience with modern development practices such as test-driven (TDD) or behavior driven development (BDD)
* Familiarity with test frameworks like Cucumber, Selenium.

What’s in it for you
  
  
At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long-term financial security.
  
  
**Our Base Benefits, Wellbeing, And Total Rewards Include**

This role provides advanced-level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases under general direction, and leads backend optimization, data integration, documentation, and secure, scalable architecture aligned with enterprise standards.

* Provides senior level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases. Integrates third party products.

* Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
* Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
* Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.
* Elevates code into the development, test, and production environments on schedule. Provides follow up production support. Submits change control requests and documents.
* Thoroughly understands software development methodology. Thoroughly understands development architecture standards. Trains and mentors staff with less experience. Resolves elevated issues.
* Participates in design, code, and test inspections throughout the life cycle to identify issues. Explains technical considerations at related meetings, including those with internal clients. Performs systems analysis activities.
* Thoroughly understands client business functions and technology needs. Has a broad understanding of Vanguard's technologies, tools, and applications, including those that interface with business area and systems.
* Interfaces with cross functional team members, and communicates systems issues at the appropriate technical level for each audience.
* Thoroughly understands and complies with Information Technology and Information Security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads.
* Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
* Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
* Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in software development, system integration, database design, and back-end architecture.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in relevant fields such as Computer Science, or a Master’s degree/Diploma in Computer Science.
* Expertise in server-side development, system integration, and API management; strong knowledge of database design, optimization, debugging, and performance tuning.
* Must-have skills: Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Node JS, AWS, CloudFormation, ECS, Fargate, DynamoDB, S3, Lambda, IAM, SQL queries, GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo, CI/CD, TDD/BDD, Splunk, Honeycomb, Python.
* Knowledge of Agile, Confluence, JIRA; aptitude for continuous process improvement for process flows/workflows.
* AWS Cloud Practitioner certification preferred.
* Adobe Experience Manager, AWS Cloud background.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
**Benefits**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.
