title: Senior Technical Consultant: Salesforce(Automotive Experience)
description:
**Description**
**Executive Summary & Organizational Context**
Within Salesforce Professional Services, the Senior Technical Consultant — Automotive Cloud role occupies a vital strategic position at the bleeding edge of AI CRM and automotive industry digital transformation. As automotive enterprises navigate sweeping market disruptions—from electric vehicle transitions and direct-to-consumer sales models to connected vehicle telemetry and autonomous fleets—this role serves as the bridge between pioneering platform capabilities and real-world enterprise execution.
  
  
Salesforce stands as the #1 AI CRM, defining an ecosystem where humans with agents drive customer success together. It is an organizational environment where ambition meets action, technology meets trust, and innovation functions as an operating principle. As Salesforce leads global workforce transformation in the agentic era, the practice actively seeks Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through artificial intelligence, driving rapid innovation, and keeping core values like trust at the center of every client commitment. Operating in a paradigm where Agentforce represents the future of autonomous and assisted AI interactions, incoming talent directly shapes the trajectory of Salesforce by translating cutting-edge platform capabilities into measurable enterprise value.
  
  
The Senior Technical Consultant operates as a hands-on advisor positioned directly at the intersection of Salesforce platform architecture and deep automotive domain knowledge. Covering an enterprise scope that spans Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), authorized dealership networks, commercial fleet operators, and emerging mobility providers, the consultant acts as the trusted technical voice for client leadership navigating complex digital transformations. In this capacity, the consultant leads critical work streams within enterprise engagements by architecting solutions, guiding technical implementation teams, presenting and defending technical designs before client governing bodies, evaluating complex solution trade-offs, proactively mitigating architectural risk, and seeing issues through to complete resolution.
  
  
Building upon this organizational mission, the following section outlines the specific technical responsibilities, domain implementations, and high-impact work streams that define daily execution in this role.
  
  

* Strategic Impact & Core Responsibilities The Senior Technical Consultant accelerates time-to-value, mitigates architecture-level risk, and drives sustained enterprise value across high-stakes customer engagements. By combining hands-on technical design with strategic risk management, the role ensures that automotive clients successfully translate complex platform capabilities into resilient, scalable operational outcomes. Technical Architecture & Work Stream Leadership
* Lead the end-to-end technical design and delivery of dedicated work streams within the automotive domain, maximizing the capabilities of Salesforce Automotive Cloud and adjacent platform components.
* Author and govern application and technical design documents (ADD/TDD) that strictly adhere to Salesforce architecture best practices while seamlessly aligning with the client's broader enterprise ecosystem—including legacy Dealer Management Systems (DMS), vehicle telemetry data pipelines, and connected vehicle cloud infrastructure.
* Establish and enforce robust technical standards across the full Salesforce stack, guiding project teams on optimal integration patterns (REST, SOAP, and event-driven architectures), environment management frameworks, deployment pipelines, and automated testing strategies.

**Core Automotive Domain Implementation**
Architect and deploy tailored, enterprise-grade capabilities across primary functional automotive work streams:
  
  

* Vehicle Lifecycle Management: Implement end-to-end tracking of vehicle assets from manufacturing assembly through inventory pipeline, retail sale, warranty period, and secondary market disposition—integrating telematics data to create a living, single source of truth for every VIN.
* Dealer Network Operations: Streamline OEM-to-dealer interactions by unifying lead distribution, co-op sales programs, inventory sharing, and warranty claim processing, ensuring consistent brand standards and transparent operational visibility across distributed retail networks.
* Fleet Management: Construct scalable multi-vehicle management frameworks that support commercial fleet accounts, enabling centralized tracking of preventative maintenance schedules, driver assignments, telematics alerts, and contract lifecycles.
* Service Scheduling & Retention: Connect vehicle telematics and diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs) directly into intelligent dealer service scheduling workflows, driving proactive maintenance outreach, reducing customer friction, and maximizing dealer workshop utilization.
* Customer Journey Orchestration: Unify siloed customer data across OEM marketing, dealership sales, and aftersales service channels to execute personalized, multi-channel customer journeys that enhance lifetime customer value and brand loyalty.

**AI-Native Delivery & Future-Proofing**

* Drive continuous up-skilling in AI Fluency and AI-native delivery practices, leveraging Agentforce capabilities to power domain-specific automotive use cases such as intelligent dealer assist, connected vehicle conversational agents, and predictive service recommendations.
* Operationalize advanced AI developer tools and assistants—specifically Agentforce Vibes, Cursor, and Claude—into daily delivery workflows to streamline complex APEX code generation, automate unit test creation, accelerate technical design drafting, and maintain superior delivery velocity and code quality.

**Advisory, Risk Management & Mentorship**

* Provide hands-on advisory leadership during critical project inflection points, rapidly troubleshooting complex technical issues, performing root-cause analyses, and driving technical impediments through to full resolution.
* Manage high-stakes client expectations by negotiating complex technical solutions and architecture trade-offs across executive client leadership, OEM technology groups, and third-party systems integrators.
* Actively mentor junior consultants and technical architects, instilling technical rigor and sharing domain assets to grow and scale the broader Automotive Services Practice.

Executing these technical responsibilities and high-impact work streams requires a proven foundation of enterprise architecture experience, platform mastery, and specialized automotive domain acumen.
  
  

* Candidate Profile: Qualifications & Experience To maintain high standards of technical delivery and domain credibility, candidates must demonstrate a rigorous combination of enterprise architecture depth, hands-on implementation experience, and specialized automotive sector intelligence.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Industry Cloud Delivery: 2+ years of hands-on Salesforce delivery experience with Automotive Cloud or a directly adjacent industry cloud (Manufacturing Cloud or Consumer Goods Cloud), backed by demonstrated automotive domain delivery artifacts.
* Architecture & Delivery Experience: 7+ years of total experience as a Lead Developer or Solution Architect, with a proven track record of delivering complex software solutions within mid-to-large-scale enterprise organizations.
* Automotive Domain Acumen: Deep domain knowledge of core automotive business processes, including vehicle sales and financing, aftersales service operations, dealer network management, commercial fleet operations, or connected vehicle data platforms.
* Enterprise Architecture Mastery: Extensive experience designing and implementing enterprise integration patterns (REST/SOAP web services, asynchronous event-driven architectures), Single Sign-On (SSO) federations, Master Data Management (MDM) strategies, and Data Lake/CDP connections.
* Specialized Systems Integration: Proven expertise integrating Salesforce with specialized automotive applications, including Dealer Management System (DMS) platforms (e.g., CDK, Reynolds & Reynolds, Tekion), telematics ingestion platforms, and proprietary OEM back-end systems.
* Methodology & Process Design: Demonstrated proficiency in Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies, supported by a track record of analyzing, designing, and optimizing complex business processes through technology.
* Executive Communication & Engagement: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to articulate, present, and defend complex technical architectures before developer teams, business steering committees, and C-suite executives.
* Autonomy & Leadership: Ability to operate independently, navigate high levels of organizational ambiguity, and drive project outcomes as a self-starter.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business, or a related technical field.

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Full-Stack AI Compute Architect
description:
**Full-Stack AI Compute Architect**

**Hyderabad, India | On-site**

**Experience: 12 + Years**

**About OXMIQ**

OXMIQ provides complete hardware and software GPU IP that lets our customers build their own AI silicon. Founded by Raja Koduri, we recently closed a $35M Series A (co-led by Samsung Catalyst Fund and Fundomo, with MediaTek, Intel Capital, and others), bringing total funding to $60M, with Jim Keller joining our board.

Our OxCore architecture combines scalar, tensor, SIMT, and orchestration engines on one platform — delivering CUDA compatibility alongside a fully programmable architecture. On top of it runs OxPython, our software stack that runs existing CUDA and PyTorch code unmodified with day-zero support for new AI models. We have an established team and a working stack, and we're now shifting from development to production — hardening the platform and scaling it for inference at real customer scale.

You'll join the OXMIQ architecture team, which sets the direction of our software, silicon, and systems. You'll help refine our software strategy and deliver the highest-performance solutions by optimizing the whole stack — from AI models and frameworks at the top down to kernel and hardware-level code generation.

**The Scope of This Role**

This role spans the AI software stack from models on down — the full vertical path a workload travels: from a model authored in frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or ONNX, through graph capture and the compiler, into the runtime and scheduler, down to individual kernels and the instructions that execute on OxCore.

We're looking for an architect who is fluent across that whole range — someone who can reason about how a transformer or diffusion model is structured
*and*
about warp divergence and register allocation, and who can make the choices that connect those layers into one coherent, high-performance platform. You won't be the deepest specialist at every layer, but you should be able to hold the whole range in your head and drive decisions end to end.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Refine the technical direction of OxPython, the OXMIQ software stack — from framework front-ends (PyTorch, JAX, ONNX) and model ingestion, through graph capture, the compiler, runtime, and driver layers, down to kernels — in close partnership with the existing software team.
* Own how AI models map onto the platform: understand how modern workloads (LLMs, diffusion, vision, agentic inference, and beyond) are structured and expressed at the framework level, and shape how they are captured, partitioned, and lowered so they run unmodified with day-zero support and scale efficiently for inference.
* Own whole-stack performance: drive optimization end to end, identify and remove bottlenecks at every layer — from graph-level and framework-level inefficiencies down through compiler, runtime, driver, and kernels — and close the gap to peak hardware utilization.
* Guide the graph and compiler strategy: MLIR dialect and IR design, lowering pipelines, operator representation, and LLVM backend code generation targeting Oxmiq hardware IP.
* Architect work orchestration across OxCore's scalar, tensor, and SIMT engines, and shape the compiler/runtime approach that runs CUDA-optimized models unmodified — preserving day-zero support for new AI models without sacrificing programmability.
* Advance the SIMT execution and parallel compute strategy: thread/warp scheduling, divergence handling, occupancy, and the memory hierarchy, and how parallel workloads are expressed, lowered, and mapped onto the hardware.
* Refine and optimize the strategy for kernel programming models (including Triton-based and custom op lowering), kernel fusion, and tiling, in collaboration with kernel engineers.
* Design for scale and production: ensure solutions grow cleanly with customer workloads, deployment sizes, and model complexity, and harden them for real-world delivery.
* Work with architecture and hardware teams to translate performance requirements into efficient code generation and runtime strategies, and feed software needs back into hardware definition.
* Drive the software/hardware validation strategy — evolving how the stack and silicon are co-verified as we scale from bring-up through production.
* Raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and architecture discussions, and mentor engineers across the frameworks, compiler, runtime, and kernel teams.
* Guide performance profiling, benchmarking, and root cause analysis for compiler- and runtime-generated code.

**Required Qualifications**

* 12+ years building systems and/or AI-infrastructure software, with a track record of owning architecture for a major component or a full stack that spans multiple layers.
* Breadth across the AI software stack — you can reason about the problem from the model and framework level down to the kernel and instruction level, and understand how choices at one layer constrain the others.
* Hands-on experience with ML frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, ONNX) and a solid understanding of how deep learning models are structured, expressed, captured, and optimized — not just at the operator level but as whole graphs and workloads.
* Strong expertise in C++ and compiler infrastructure, including LLVM (IR, pass infrastructure, backend code generation) and MLIR (dialect design, conversion passes, progressive lowering).
* Deep expertise in SIMT and parallel compute architectures — thread/warp execution models, divergence, synchronization, occupancy constraints, and memory hierarchies.
* Proven experience with GPU programming models, including CUDA, and an understanding of what it takes to deliver CUDA compatibility on non-NVIDIA hardware.
* Solid command of code generation concepts — instruction selection, scheduling, register allocation, vectorization, and memory hierarchy optimization.
* Experience co-designing software alongside silicon or shaping a hardware-software interface.
* Strong debugging and performance analysis skills, and a bias toward shipping: you prototype, measure, and make decisions with incomplete information.
* Hands-on experience with Claude Code or equivalent AI-assisted development workflows.

*Note: we expect exceptional depth in some of these areas and working fluency across the rest. The essential requirement is the ability to operate across the whole stack, not mastery of every layer.*

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience architecting compiler backends or runtimes for custom AI accelerators, NPUs, or GPU IP.
* Experience with graph-level model optimization, framework integration internals (e.g., PyTorch compile/inductor, XLA), or serving/inference infrastructure for large models.
* Experience with Triton or similar high-level GPU kernel frameworks, and with kernel fusion, operator tiling, and auto-tuning.
* Exposure to quantization, mixed-precision, or sparsity-aware compilation techniques.
* Experience with performance modeling and roofline analysis for GPU workloads.
* Background in deep learning, computer vision, image processing, or video — the workloads our customers run.
* Experience bringing up and scaling a software stack on new or pre-silicon hardware into production.
* Contributions to open-source compiler, runtime, or ML-framework projects such as LLVM, MLIR, PyTorch, or Triton.

**Education**

B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech/MS/Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

**Why OXMIQ**

You'll join a well-funded company — fresh off a $35M Series A backed by Samsung, MediaTek, Intel Capital, and others, with Jim Keller on our board — with an established team and a proven stack, at the point where we're scaling it into a production platform in customers' hands. You'll work directly with the people designing the hardware it runs on.

This is a role for an architect who wants to refine and optimize the AI software stack end to end — from models and frameworks down to kernels and silicon — rather than just one layer of it, and measure success in shipped, high-performance solutions.

**Compensation & Benefits**

OXMIQ offers a competitive compensation package, including base salary, equity participation, comprehensive medical coverage, and the opportunity to contribute to foundational silicon and software technology.

***OXMIQ is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.***

title: Application Engineer - II
description:

**About Vanguard**

**Vanguard India**

description:

We are seeking a high-caliber Principal / Lead Cloud AI Solutions Engineer with deep expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and modern Enterprise AI paradigms. Strong, hands-on enterprise-level expertise in EITHER Python OR Java (Tracks are evaluated separately; expertise in at least one is mandatory).
  
  
Proven track record building enterprise microservices, REST APIs, and distributed event-driven applications.
  
  
  

* Technical & Cloud Architecture

Deep technical knowledge of distributed system design, enterprise application integration, and relational/non-relational database technologies.
  
  
Advanced expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) core services: Google Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Functions, BigQuery, and Pub/Sub.
  
  
Production experience with Docker, Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, and enterprise CI/CD automation pipelines.

Hands-on proficiency in building and deploying models via Vertex AI and integrating foundation models via the Gemini API.
  
  
Demonstrated experience constructing end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems and configuring Vertex AI Vector Search for embeddings and semantic search.
  
  
Practical experience designing agentic AI workflows and establishing automated evaluation metrics (“evals”) for enterprise AI applications.
  
  
  

* Client & Leadership Capabilities

Experience in customer-facing roles, driving technical discovery, solutioning, and executive-level technical discussions.
  
  
Strong problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills with a track record of optimizing application performance.
  
  
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between technical complexity and business strategy.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
GCP Professional Cloud Architect or GCP Professional Machine Learning Engineer certification.
  
  
Experience in regulated industries (FinTech, Healthcare, Enterprise SaaS) with strict security and compliance considerations.
  
  
Knowledge of FinOps and cloud cost-optimization strategies for large-scale GenAI workloads.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Architecture & System Design: Architect and implement resilient, scalable, and high-throughput enterprise systems and microservices using GCP-native cloud frameworks.
  
  
GenAI & Agentic Engineering: Build and deploy enterprise GenAI applications leveraging Vertex AI, Gemini API, Vertex AI Vector Search, RAG pipelines, and agentic AI workflows. Establish automated evaluation loops (“evals”) to measure model performance, drift, and accuracy.
  
  
Full-Lifecycle Engineering: Lead end-to-end delivery—including technical requirement gathering, architectural blueprints, Proofs of Concept (PoCs), production integration, deployment, and performance optimization.
  
  
Cloud & DevOps Orchestration: Implement robust CI/CD pipelines and manage containerized microservices across Google Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, and BigQuery using Docker and Kubernetes.
  
  
Customer & Stakeholder Engagement: Serve as the technical authority in direct client engagements, translating business requirements into actionable engineering roadmaps and conducting technical deep dives.
  
  
Technical Leadership: Guide engineering teams through design and code reviews, mentor junior engineers, establish best practices, and drive technical excellence across cross-functional initiatives.

**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!

GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. description: DescriptionCome help Amazon Books create and deploy the technology that gets every book, audiobook, and digital title in front of readers around the world. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world's most beloved brands, and customer obsession is part of our company DNA. On the Books publishing technology team, our customers are the authors and publishers who trust us with their work and the readers who discover it. Our SDEs use the latest technology to solve complex problems in catalog orchestration, publishing workflows, and reporting, and they get to see the impact of their work first-hand.We are looking for individuals who are passionate about creating new products, features, and services from scratch while managing ambiguity and the pace of a team where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years. title: Principal Apps AI Consultant
description:
**Overview**
Microsoft Industry Solutions - Global Center Innovation and Delivery Center (GCID) delivers end-to-end solutions by enabling accelerated adoption and productive use of Microsoft technologies. An organization of well over 1000+ exceptional people, GCID presents a great opportunity for highly skilled services professionals to make a foray into consulting, solution development and delivery roles.
  
  
Senior leader responsible for the successful technical execution and delivery of complex client projects across diverse domains. This role acts as a strategic anchor between clients, senior leadership, delivery managers, project managers, and delivery teams. In the AI-first GCID organization, Architect(s) are expected to embed AI-native thinking into delivery models, ensuring solutions are intelligent, scalable, and aligned with business outcomes. The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, demonstrates breadth of expertise, and advocates for solutions that deliver true client value.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**AI-First Delivery Leadership**

* Embed AI-first principles into delivery workflows, leveraging automation and intelligent orchestration where applicable.
* Own the Architecture and drive end-to-end delivery of complex projects, ensuring solutions are scalable, robust, and aligned with client business outcomes.
* Drive engineering excellence through reusable components, accelerators, and scalable architecture.
* Oversee technical execution across multiple projects, ensuring adherence to best practices, quality standards, and compliance requirements.
* Collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to define strategies, delivery plans, milestones, and risk mitigation approaches.
* Act as a technical point of contact for clients, translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Ensure delivery models are optimized for modern, AI-native execution, including integration of automation and intelligent processes.
* Ability to step into at‑risk projects, quickly assess issues, and establish a credible path to recovery or exit.

**Engineering Excellence**

* Champion high-quality engineering practices across all delivery engagements.
* Ensure adherence to coding standards, architectural integrity, and performance benchmarks.
* Define and institutionalize engineering guardrails that embed secure coding, test‑driven development, observability.
* Encourage continuous learning and technical certifications to maintain cutting-edge expertise.
* Drive adoption of modern delivery methodologies (Agile, DevOps, CI/CD) to ensure robust and scalable solutions.
* Foster a culture of technical rigor, innovation, and accountability within the team.

**Innovation & Thought Leadership**

* Monitor and evaluate emerging technologies to inform strategic direction.
* Lead innovation in delivery models, reusable assets, and accelerators to enhance efficiency and impact.
* Champion modern thinking and best practices across teams and engagements to foster a culture of continuous improvement.

**Client Engagement & Solutioning**

* Use design thinking to shape user‑centric solutions, aligning business goals, architecture decisions, and delivery execution.
* Engage with clients to understand business needs and provide expert guidance throughout the project lifecycle.
* Support pre-sales and solutioning efforts with estimations, proof-of-concepts, and technical proposals.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and value delivery.

**Team Management & Mentorship**

* Lead and mentor cross-functional teams, fostering a culture of learning, collaboration, and technical excellence.
* Conduct reviews, provide feedback, and support professional development of team members.

**Quality & Compliance**

* Ensure secure, compliant, and reliable solution delivery through secure coding, test‑driven development, observability, design reviews, and quality gates across all engagements.

**Strategic Partnering**

* Serve as a strategic partner for internal and external stakeholders on key initiatives.
* Provide strategic guidance and execution oversight to ensure alignment with organizational goals.

**Qualifications**

* 20+ years of experience in software/solution engineering, with at least 10–15 years as Architect and delivery leadership roles.
* Proven experience in leading delivery of complex, multi-disciplinary projects.
* Strong understanding of modern delivery methodologies (Agile, Scrum, DevOps, etc.).
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and team leadership skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Relevant certifications are a plus.

**Areas of Expertise**
**Full Stack Application Engineering**




+ End‑to‑end design and development of modern web and mobile applications using React, Angular, Next.js, Blazor, or equivalent frameworks
+ Strong backend engineering expertise using .NET, Java, Node.js, or Python, applying clean architecture, domain‑driven design, and API‑first principles
+ Experience building scalable microservices and distributed systems, leveraging REST, gRPC, event‑driven architectures, and asynchronous processing
+ Hands‑on data and platform fundamentals, including relational and NoSQL databases (Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB), performance tuning, scalability, resiliency, and application security

**AI‑Driven Application Development**




+ Build AI‑driven, cloud‑native applications with intelligence embedded into core workflows.
+ Hands‑on use of GitHub Copilot across the SDLC, enabling solutioning, development, CI/CD, and production readiness.
+ Lead a Copilot‑assisted engineering culture, driving AI pair‑programming and high‑velocity delivery at scale.
+ Modernize large application estates using Copilot‑assisted code comprehension, refactoring, and cloud‑native migration.
+ Coach teams and customers on safe, enterprise‑grade Copilot usage, prompt strategies, and adoption patterns.
+ Apply Responsible AI principles, embedding security, privacy, governance, and compliance into delivery workflows.

**AI‑Enabled Application Development**




+ Deliver production‑grade AI solutions using Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services, Azure AI Foundry, and custom ML, including RAG architectures with Azure AI Search and enterprise data grounding.
+ Deep expertise in LLM integration—prompt engineering, context and grounding strategies—for copilots, conversational applications, and intelligent business workflows.
+ Proven design of agentic AI systems (single and multi‑agent), with orchestration, tools, memory, human‑in‑the‑loop, and enterprise‑ready operations including observability, governance, and cost/performance optimization.

**Cloud‑Native Architecture (Azure)**




+ Design PaaS‑first, cloud‑native Azure architectures, prioritizing managed services for scale, resilience, security, and efficiency.
+ Architect solutions across App Service, Container Apps, AKS, Functions, and API Management, selecting optimal compute per workload and business need.
+ Strong expertise in identity, security, and networking, including Entra ID, RBAC, Managed Identity, Key Vault, private endpoints, VNET integration, and landing patterns.
+ Build highly available and resilient systems, including multi‑region deployments, disaster recovery, and fault‑tolerant architectures.
+ Apply cost‑aware and Well‑Architected principles, optimizing reliability, performance, operations, and cost efficiency.

**DevOps, Platform & Developer Productivity**




+ Design and operate secure CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions with automated build, test, and deployment.
+ Hands‑on Infrastructure‑as‑Code using Bicep, ARM, and Terraform, leveraging GitHub Copilot to enforce enterprise standards.
+ Deep understanding of observability and reliability engineering, including logging, metrics, tracing, SLOs, alerting, and production readiness.
+ Drive developer productivity and delivery velocity through inner‑source practices, reusable platforms, accelerators, and automation.
+ Embed DevSecOps and platform engineering, delivering paved‑road, self‑service capabilities that balance speed, governance, reliability, and compliance.

**Solutioning, Pre-Sales & Technical Leadership**




+ Lead technical solutioning, estimations, and support architecture design during pre-sales and delivery shaping
+ Translate business outcomes into clear architecture, execution plans, and risk mitigation strategies
+ Influence technical direction across multiple teams and engagements
+ Act as a trusted advisor to clients and internal leadership

**Frontier Engineering & Customer Enablement Skills**




+ Lead rapid prototyping, pilots, and early enterprise deployments, taking ideas from whiteboard to production with minimal friction
+ Hands‑on troubleshooting and production support, addressing performance, reliability, and security issues to unblock progress
+ Side‑by‑side engineering engagement with customer teams, accelerating deployments, adoption, and time‑to‑value through direct coding support
+ Outcome‑driven delivery in ambiguous, high‑pressure environments, building reusable accelerators and reference implementations while engaging senior customer stakeholders

**Personal Attributes**




+ Passion for technology and innovation.
+ Ability to interact confidently with senior leaders and clients.
+ Strong decision-making skills and a consultative mindset.
+ Flexibility to manage in a fast-moving, ambiguous consulting environment.
+ Commitment to continuous learning and professional growth.

**Other**

* Embody our culture and values

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
  
  
Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. description:
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
This role provides expert-level IT technical lead services, including the integration and implementation of technologies, while applying deep backend expertise to optimize performance, ensure secure architecture, and enhance system scalability.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provides expert-level technical leadership for critical software, middleware, or hardware projects across multiple platforms, ensuring successful architecture, development, and implementation. Evaluates and approves development options and technical deliverables. Oversees comprehensive testing for functionality, performance, and security.
* Approves technical solutions proposed by team members, resolves complex technical problems, and anticipates issues to enable preventive action.
* Acts as a key technical liaison with stakeholders, effectively communicating technical implications, project risks, and solution strategies.
* Maintains expertise in IT methodologies, architecture design, and enterprise standards; mentors staff and ensures team adoption of evolving standards.
* Reviews, authors, and approves technical documentation and architecture diagrams.
* Drives continuous improvement in technical standards, methodologies, and the adoption of emerging technologies.
* Participates in product life cycle reviews (design, code, test), and serves as a technical advisor across project meetings.
* Ensures compliance with IT and Information Security policies, validating that deliverables meet internal and external requirements.
* Leads or contributes to special projects and cross-functional initiatives as assigned.
* Applies deep server-side development skills, focusing on performance optimization, secure architecture, and database efficiency.
* Troubleshoots complex system performance issues and recommends improvements to optimize data flow across services and APIs.
* Ensures scalable and resilient backend functionality, with proactive measures for increased system demands

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Minimum 8 years of experience in software development, architecture, and system integration.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science or IT, or Bachelor’s in Computer Applications (BCA), or Master’s in Computer Applications (MCA).
* Expertise in software architecture, system design, and technical leadership, with strong experience delivering scalable enterprise applications.
* Hands-on experience with Java, Python, Spring Boot, Node.js, RESTful APIs, GraphQL/Supergraph, and modern development frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of AWS services (ECS, Lambda, DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, S3, SQS, SNS, IAM), including containerized/serverless architectures and Infrastructure as Code.
* Experience with DB2, PostgreSQL, SQL, Kafka Streams, Attunity, Qlik, data integration, and cloud-based data solutions.
* Proven expertise in Git, CI/CD, test automation, observability, Secure SDLC, Agile delivery, technical leadership, stakeholder management, and mentoring engineering teams.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
**Benefits**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
Position in this function builds, configures and supports secure AI integrations that connect business-unit data and services to AI platforms. On Optum Technology's AI Engineering connector team, you will deliver plugins, connectors, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and related components across Microsoft Copilot, OpenAI, Anthropic and Google ecosystems. This is a hands-on implementation, testing and operational support role, not primarily model training or ETL development. Partner with source owners, platform teams and reviewers to move approved integrations from intake through validation, launch and ongoing support.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Translate business intake into implementation designs with source owners and AI Engineering; confirm approved scope, data boundaries, acceptance criteria and leadership priorities
* Build and configure AI connectors, plugins, MCP servers and, where approved, skills packages. Validate submitted manifests, API contracts, tool schemas, skill and instruction files, platform-specific packaging and custom code before onboarding; account for instruction differences across platforms
* Implement approved authentication and authorization, including Entra app registrations, delegated OAuth, least-privilege permissions and source-to-platform access mapping; coordinate IAM approvals
* Deliver safe retrieval and, where explicitly approved, write capabilities that respect source entitlements, data-use limits and enterprise gateway requirements
* Engineer reliable API behavior with pagination, bounded retries, rate-limit handling, synchronization controls and actionable error handling
* Create unit, integration, end-to-end, security and performance tests; validate authentication, retrieval, access mapping and sync behavior in sandbox and staging environments
* Use formal intake with technical evidence for architecture, Security, Legal and privacy reviews, including AIRB/ESRO where applicable. Retain catalog provenance through AID or approval metadata where required to distinguish reviewed artifacts from unauthorized uploads. Implement approved controls without substituting for approval owners; help control owners define evolving custom-agent governance
* Administer platform configuration and registrations, including M365 where relevant, and explain integration usage. Deploy only through approved development, test and production environments, least-privilege access and release gates; prevent direct production creation or uploads that bypass review. Maintain reusable configuration and onboarding templates
* Maintain version-controlled code, peer reviews and CI/CD checks; document API changes, configuration, deployment and recovery procedures
* Instrument monitoring and alerts, protect sensitive data in logs and maintain runbooks for support, access changes, onboarding and audit evidence
* Diagnose integration failures and network reachability, internet, gateway and firewall dependencies with AI Catalog, cloud, platform, network and source teams. Revert configuration or roll back releases safely, establish root causes and preventive fixes, and escalate to vendor technical support with reproducible evidence
* Supply test evidence and support readiness for pilot, limited availability (LA) and general availability (GA) gates; work with the manager and project manager on risks, dependencies and user feedback
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications**

* Primary: demonstrated AI integration development

+ Demonstrated hands-on development, deployment, platform configuration and troubleshooting of connectors, plugins or MCP servers through a validated pilot or production release on at least one AI platform, with transferable diagnostic skills across ecosystems. Explain architecture, package structures, tests and failure handling; diagnose authorization/token endpoints, service principals, client IDs and callbacks, including differences between Entra and source-managed or custom identity providers. Generic model-training, ETL or UI-only administration experience alone does not meet this requirement
+ Experience connecting enterprise APIs or data sources to at least one AI platform, with practical understanding of authentication, source authorization mapping and safe retrieval or approved tool execution

* Secondary: programming and software delivery

+ Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Demonstrated problem-solving and clear technical documentation for implementation and support partners
+ Solid Python or Java development experience and ability to work with the other language. Three or more years of hands-on software or integration development, or equivalent demonstrated capability, proposed for HR review. Demonstrate reading and debugging custom integration code, validating submitted packages, and delivering tested configuration and deployment changes. Working knowledge of REST/JSON, OAuth, automated testing, version control, peer review and CI/CD

* Tertiary: governance, legal review and data privacy

+ Familiarity with AI and enterprise governance, legal review, data privacy and least-privilege principles. Ability to document data flows and controls, participate in required reviews, implement approved restrictions and escalate risks. Approval authority remains with designated architecture, Security, Legal, privacy and IAM owners

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with TypeScript or C#, Azure, Copilot Studio or Power Platform
* Healthcare or other regulated-enterprise integration experience, including careful handling of protected or sensitive information
* Microsoft 365 integration packaging, Entra administration or enterprise gateway experience
* Knowledge of integration delivery across multiple AI ecosystems, with reusable onboarding patterns, observability and production incident response

**Measures of Success**

* Accepted integrations satisfy agreed business use cases, source authorization boundaries and platform compatibility requirements
* Test evidence demonstrates secure access, reliable retrieval and synchronization, and performance against jointly agreed acceptance criteria; material defects are resolved before rollout
* Pilot, LA and GA releases pass required approval and operational-readiness gates with documented configuration, support ownership and rollback or recovery procedures
* Monitoring detects meaningful failures; incidents are resolved with source teams and preventive fixes reduce recurring integration issues
* Reusable packages, templates and runbooks improve repeatability and onboarding lead time against an agreed baseline, informed by pilot feedback

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Full Stack Developer — someone who spends the majority of their time designing, building, and operating data pipelines, integrations, and data models, and who also brings solid full-stack development skills to build the APIs and interfaces that expose that data. This is a data engineering-first role with meaningful full-stack exposure, not the other way around.

**Key Responsibilities**

Data Engineering (primary focus)

- Design, build, and operate data pipelines (ETL/ELT) that ingest, transform, and reconcile data across multiple systems and data stores.

- Own data modeling and schema design, including defining data contracts shared across the platform.

- Build event-driven data integration flows, ensuring idempotent processing and reliable data delivery between services.

- Integrate with third-party and legacy systems, handling mismatched data models, partial failures, and reconciliation logic.

- Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data pipeline performance, reliability, and data quality.

- Collaborate with architects and product teams to define shared data stores, contracts, and access patterns.

- Instrument pipelines and features for experimentation, measurement, and data-quality monitoring.

Full-Stack Development (supporting focus)

- Build and maintain full-stack product features, front-end interfaces and backend/API services, that expose and consume the underlying data.

- Design and implement RESTful APIs and service-layer components on top of the data platform.

- Ensure secure, scalable, and maintainable development practices across both data and application layers.

- Contribute to code reviews, automated testing, release readiness, and production support.

**Required Skills and Experience**

- 7-8 years of professional experience, with the majority of that time spent building data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, or data integration systems in production.

- Strong SQL and data modeling skills, comfortable designing schemas for both operational and analytical use.

- Hands-on experience with event-driven data integration patterns and idempotent processing.

- Experience integrating with third-party or legacy systems, including data mapping, transformation, and reconciliation logic.

- Working full-stack development skills: backend service development (Node.js, Python, or Java) with RESTful API design, plus front-end development skills (JavaScript/TypeScript, React or an equivalent framework).

- Experience with cloud-native data and application delivery (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including serverless/managed services such as Lambda/Functions, event buses, and managed NoSQL or relational databases.

- Solid understanding of distributed system reliability and data pipeline observability (monitoring, alerting, data-quality checks).

- Strong collaboration skills across data, engineering, and product teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

- Experience with data warehousing or analytics platforms (e.g., Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery).

- Experience with workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, Step Functions).

- Experience building search, routing, or matching/assignment systems.

- Experience with CRM or contact-center platform integrations.

- Experience with AI-assisted or chat-driven product interfaces.

- Experience instrumenting features or pipelines for A/B testing and experimentation.

title: Software Development Engineer, Time & Pay Innovation
description: DescriptionAmazon is one of the largest employers on the planet with hundreds of thousands of employees across the globe. Come join us in our journey to deliver solutions for one of the most complex domains in People eXperience Technology (PXT). Your code determines how Amazon associates get paid — accurately, on time, every single day. As an SDE-II in TAA, you own and deliver features across one of Amazon's most critical real-time platforms: a high-throughput, event-driven architecture processing millions of IoT punch events globally. You don't just write code — you own systems. We own and deliver technology to manage employee time expectations and compute their pay, globally, for all our current and emerging businesses. At the core, we are in the business of analytics — real-time and event-driven — of data collected from IoT devices (time clocks) and web user interfaces. We own our own high-availability services to support this processing, and require the ability to work from replay-able, auditable "truth" for any point in an employee's timeline. Our business rules are complex and arcane, varying by role, business, and jurisdiction. We are solving all these problems at Amazon scale, an order of magnitude larger than supported by any commodity solutions and growing exponentially.We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II who is a strong, independent builder with growing design maturity. You take ownership of significant features and components, drive them from design through production, and operate them with high standards. You write high-quality code, make sound technical decisions with appropriate trade-offs, and proactively improve the systems you touch. You are developing your ability to influence design direction, mentor junior engineers, and think beyond your immediate deliverables to the health of the broader system.Key job responsibilities Own the design and delivery of significant features and components across scalable, multi-tiered applications and services. Drive projects from requirements through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production operation.Write high-quality, well-tested production code using modern languages, design patterns, and frameworks. Hold yourself and your peers to high standards through thorough code reviews. Make sound technical decisions with appropriate trade-offs. Evaluate options for caching, retry strategies, concurrency, and data modeling. Justify your choices and communicate trade-offs clearly.Design and build for scale and resilience. Consider failure modes, rate limits, traffic bursts, and downstream dependency health in your designs. Implement patterns like backpressure, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation. Own operational excellence for your systems. Monitor production health, respond to alarms, investigate root causes, and drive fixes. Write runbooks, improve observability, and reduce operational burden over time.Contribute to system-level design discussions. Participate actively in design reviews — propose solutions, challenge assumptions, and help the team arrive at better architectures.Mentor junior engineers. Support SDE-Is through code reviews, pairing sessions, and technical guidance. Help them grow their skills and develop good engineering habits. Understand and translate business requirements. Work with stakeholders to understand complex domain rules across punch processing, attendance, scheduling, and compliance. Turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical designs.Identify and resolve technical debt proactively. Improve code quality, simplify complex logic, optimize performance, and refactor systems to support future growth — without being asked.Contribute to team processes and culture. Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and on-call rotations. Raise the bar for engineering practices and help improve team velocity.A day in the lifeYou start the day reviewing a design you wrote for a new feature in the compliance system — incorporating feedback from a senior engineer on edge cases around jurisdiction-specific rules. You update the design, get alignment, and start building. Mid-morning, you review a code change from a junior engineer, leaving constructive feedback on error handling and test coverage. After lunch, you investigate a latency spike in one of your services — tracing requests through logs and metrics, identifying a downstream throttling issue, and implementing a retry optimization. You join a design review for a cross-team project, asking questions about failure modes and proposing an alternative caching approach. You close the day deploying your feature to a pre-production environment, validating metrics, and updating the team on progress in standup.About The TeamWe are Time and Attendance (TAA) team within People eXperience Technology (PXT). Our team builds and operates the technology that powers how Amazon tracks, manages, and compensates employee time — globally, across all business lines and geographies.Basic Qualifications 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field Experience programming with at least one software programming languagePreferred Qualifications 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalentOur inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Network Development Engineer, Platform Development
description:
Founded in 2004, NetBrain is the leader in no-code network automation. Its ground-breaking Next-Gen platform provides IT operations teams with the ability to scale their hybrid multi-cloud connected networks by automating the processes associated with Diagnostic Troubleshooting, Outage Prevention and Protected Change Management. Today, over 2,500 of the world’s largest enterprises and managed services providers leverage NetBrain’s platform.
  
  
***What We Need***
NetBrain is looking for a Network Development Engineer with a focus on Platform Development to join our growing Platform team. In this role, you will apply deep Python expertise and networking knowledge to design and build scalable integration solutions that power Net Brain’s automation platform. You will work directly with enterprise customers to understand real-world networking challenges and translate them into robust, production-grade platform capabilities
  
  
This role combines strong software engineering expertise with deep networking knowledge and direct customer collaboration. Unlike a traditional backend-only development role, engineers in this position work closely with enterprise customers to understand real-world networking challenges and design scalable platform and integration solutions.
  
  
***What You'll Do***

* Design, develop, and maintain high-quality Python services and APIs that power Net Brain’s automation platform.
* Partner with customers and internal stakeholders to understand networking requirements and translate them into platform features.
* Own API design, feature decomposition, and technical design reviews for new platform capabilities.
* Apply strong software engineering practices: code reviews, design patterns, edge case handling, failure modeling, and production-readiness.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams on integration design and delivery.
* May need to work on customers' platform cases when needed.

***What You Bring***

* 2–4 years of hands-on Python development with emphasis on code quality, design patterns, and API design.
* Solid understanding of networking fundamentals: routing & switching (BGP, OSPF, MPLS, STP, RSTP), QoS, firewall concepts, SD-WAN, and cloud networking.
* Proven experience with API integration design and building production-grade services.
* Ability to handle edge cases, failure scenarios, and production concerns with rigor.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills; comfortable engaging directly with enterprise customers.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* Nice to have: Networking or Cloud certifications (CCNA, CCNP, AWS, Azure); experience with cloud-native architectures or AI tooling.

NetBrain invites all interested and qualified candidates to apply for employment opportunities.
  
  
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law.

To make a request, please contact our People Team at: people@netbraintech.com and we will be happy to assist you.
  
  
In compliance with applicable laws, NetBrain conducts holistic, individual background reviews in support of all hiring decisions.

* Strong expertise in Cloud Platforms including Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

* Strong competency in designing and implementing REST APIs, GraphQL services, Microservices, and Enterprise Integration frameworks.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About the Role

Aptagrim designs, engineers, and deploys specialised enterprise AI products and intelligent workflow systems built around real business knowledge, decisions, and operational workflows. Our work spans our bidPlan platform and AI engineering services for enterprise clients.

We are looking for a hands-on Full-Stack Technical Lead to build and deliver enterprise applications using
**Python, Django, Django REST Framework, React, and Next.js**
.

You will own technical implementation across the frontend, backend, databases, and deployment, while guiding a team of developers. The role requires strong backend engineering depth, practical frontend expertise, and the ability to translate business requirements into reliable, secure, and maintainable software. You should be comfortable writing code, reviewing architecture, resolving production issues, and taking features through to release.

Key Responsibilities

* **Lead full-stack development:**
  Design, develop, and maintain applications using Python, Django, DRF, Next.js, React, and TypeScript. Take ownership of features from technical design through implementation, testing, and production release.
* **Own technical design and architecture:**
  Translate product and business requirements into clear technical designs, data models, API contracts, and implementation plans. Choose appropriate monolithic, modular monolithic, or microservices architectures based on application needs.
* **Build robust backend services:**
  Develop reusable business logic and well-structured APIs with appropriate validation, authentication, authorization, pagination, versioning, and error handling.
* **Develop responsive frontend applications:**
  Build accessible, reusable interfaces using Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS or equivalent frameworks. Apply App Router, Server and Client Components, SSR, and SSG appropriately.
* **Manage frontend data and application state:**
  Implement API integration, data fetching, caching, and state management using suitable tools such as Zustand or Redux. Deliver clear loading, error, and empty states across user journeys.
* **Own database design and performance:**
  Design and maintain PostgreSQL or MySQL schemas. Optimize Django ORM usage, SQL queries, indexes, transactions, and locking to support reliable concurrent reads and writes.
* **Implement asynchronous and real-time workflows:**
  Use Redis, Celery, and Celery Beat for caching, background processing, and scheduled tasks. Apply event-driven messaging and WebSockets where required, with appropriate retry and failure handling.
* **Improve application performance and security:**
  Identify bottlenecks across browser rendering, APIs, databases, and background workers. Implement secure access controls, secrets management, and protection against common web application vulnerabilities.
* **Support deployment and operational reliability:**
  Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and containerized deployments on AWS or equivalent cloud platforms. Work with Docker, Nginx, and application servers such as Gunicorn or Uvicorn; support migrations, release checks, and rollback procedures.
* **Establish engineering quality:**
  Define coding standards, conduct code reviews, and ensure meaningful unit, integration, and end-to-end test coverage. Maintain technical documentation and API specifications using OpenAPI/Swagger.
* **Lead and mentor developers:**
  Break requirements into actionable tasks, estimate effort, identify dependencies, and guide junior and mid-level engineers. Remain actively involved in implementation and help the team resolve technical blockers.
* **Collaborate on delivery and production support:**
  Work with product managers, designers, QA, and other engineering teams to deliver agreed scope. Communicate technical risks early, investigate production incidents, and implement improvements that prevent recurrence.

Required Skills and Experience

* **5+ years of professional software development experience**
  , including substantial hands-on experience with Python/Django and React/Next.js, and demonstrated technical ownership of production applications.
* Experience leading a small engineering team or owning a significant application module, including technical planning, code reviews, mentoring, and release delivery.
* **Strong backend expertise:**
  Python, Django, Django REST Framework, Django ORM, REST API design, and maintainable application architecture.
* **Strong frontend capability:**
  React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, including responsive design, reusable components, App Router, Server and Client Components, and server-side rendering.
* Practical experience with frontend state management, API integration, caching, and performance optimization. Understanding of SEO requirements for public-facing applications.
* **Database engineering:**
  Strong SQL skills and experience with PostgreSQL or MySQL, including schema design, migrations, indexing, query optimization, transactions, and concurrency control.
* **Background processing and caching:**
  Hands-on experience with Redis and Celery, including task scheduling, retries, and reliable background execution.
* **Cloud and DevOps:**
  Experience deploying and supporting applications on AWS or an equivalent cloud platform using Docker, CI/CD pipelines, Nginx, and appropriate application servers.
* **Security:**
  Practical understanding of authentication and authorization, role-based access control, JWT, OAuth2, and secure session and token handling.
* **Testing and troubleshooting:**
  Experience with automated backend and frontend testing, production debugging, structured logging, application monitoring, and root cause analysis.
* **Engineering fundamentals:**
  Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, separation of concerns, and software design principles.
* Proficiency with Git, pull request workflows, Agile/Scrum practices, and technical documentation.
* Clear communication, sound technical judgment, and the ability to balance delivery timelines with maintainability, performance, and reliability.

**Additional experience that would be valuable:**
FastAPI, Kafka or similar messaging systems, Django Channels/WebSockets, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and observability tools such as Sentry, Grafana, or the ELK Stack. Experience integrating AI services into enterprise applications is also useful.

T&PA mission is to build world-class time systems that are intuitive and friction-free for all users, enable management of time and pay with close to zero defects, are available on-demand as new businesses launch, and flexibly support future business innovation. Collaborating with product managers and customers to manage requirements for new features and updates to existing systems

Working with some of the most talented and dedicated team members you can find
  
  
Having fun

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Forward deployed Engineer
description:
**Forward Deployed Engineer**

**Company:**
Trida Labs

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
3–5 Years

**About Trida Labs**

Trida Labs builds AI-native products that help organizations work with enterprise data, analytics, and intelligent applications.

Our products include TridaPad, an AI-native data collaboration platform for querying, analyzing, visualizing, and managing enterprise data; AgentSQL, an agentic AI analytics solution for natural-language interaction with enterprise data; and TridaPad MCP Server, which enables AI assistants and MCP-compatible clients to interact with TridaPad capabilities.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to work directly with customers and turn business and technical requirements into working solutions using Trida Labs products.

You will work across customer discovery, data integration, configuration, testing, deployment, and production troubleshooting. You will understand customer workflows, data environments, security requirements, and business needs, then configure and integrate our products to solve real-world problems.

You will also support customer pilots, technical demonstrations, and pre-sales engagements, validating solutions against customer-specific use cases and collaborating with engineering teams when product-level changes are required.

This is a customer-facing engineering role focused on configuring and extending existing capabilities rather than building customer-specific forks.

**What You'll Do**

**1. Customer Discovery & Solution Design**

* Understand customer workflows, technical requirements, data environments, and operational constraints.
* Translate business requirements into practical Trida Labs solutions.
* Identify required data sources, integrations, permissions, configurations, and deployment requirements.
* Assess technical feasibility, explain trade-offs, and define reusable implementation approaches.

**2. Pre-Sales, Pilots & Proofs of Concept**

* Support technical discussions, product demonstrations, pilots, and proofs of concept.
* Demonstrate how TridaPad and AgentSQL address customer use cases.
* Configure representative customer environments and validate technical requirements.
* Identify integration, security, and deployment constraints and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders.

**3. Product Implementation & Data Integration**

* Deploy and configure TridaPad and AgentSQL for customer requirements.
* Configure data sources, database connections, permissions, schemas, and analytics workflows.
* Integrate enterprise databases and platforms such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, and Databricks.
* Understand customer data models, relationships, and business metrics.
* Validate data accessibility and troubleshoot connectivity, permission, schema, query, and integration issues.

**4. AI & Analytics Implementation**

* Configure existing AI and analytics capabilities for customer use cases.
* Adapt prompts, context, tools, and application workflows where appropriate.
* Validate natural-language analytics, SQL generation, analytical results, visualizations, dashboards, and summaries.
* Diagnose unreliable AI outputs and distinguish data, configuration, context, model, and product issues.
* Collaborate with specialist engineering teams when core product changes are needed.

**5. Security, Access & MCP Integrations**

* Support customer security questionnaires, technical reviews, and access requirements.
* Coordinate VPN, IP allowlisting, private connectivity, restricted network, and other environment-specific requirements.
* Support self-hosted deployments in customer cloud or on-premises environments where applicable.
* Apply least-privilege principles and follow requirements for handling production data, PII, credentials, logs, and debugging information.
* Configure and validate MCP integrations with AI assistants, internal applications, and customer workflows, including authentication, permissions, and tool access.

**6. Customer Evaluation & Validation**

* Build customer-specific golden question sets containing representative business questions, expected SQL, and verified analytical results.
* Test customer configurations against schemas, terminology, metrics, permissions, and real-world questions.
* Rerun relevant tests after product, model, prompt, or configuration changes.
* Validate SQL, analytics, visualizations, dashboards, and summaries against expected outcomes.
* Track regressions, communicate actionable findings, and maintain versioned customer-specific configuration artifacts.

**7. Deployment & Production Troubleshooting**

* Prepare implementation plans and technical validation checklists.
* Support deployments across development, staging, and production environments.
* Troubleshoot application, API, database, AI, integration, and deployment issues using logs, traces, errors, and reproduction steps.
* Validate fixes against customer-relevant scenarios and support releases, upgrades, and post-deployment checks.
* Coordinate infrastructure and platform-level issues with the appropriate engineering teams.

**8. Customer Feedback & Engineering Collaboration**

* Identify recurring customer problems and distinguish implementation needs from core product requirements.
* Provide structured feedback with technical details, reproduction steps, expected behavior, and customer impact.
* Identify opportunities to convert repeated implementation work into reusable product capabilities, tools, or documentation.
* Collaborate with AI, AI Agent, Data & AI, Backend, Platform, NLP/ML, and Product teams.
* Reduce customer-specific workarounds and avoid unnecessary product forks.

**Role Ownership**

* **Forward Deployed Engineer:**
  Owns customer discovery, solution design, implementation, integration, configuration, validation, deployment, troubleshooting, and customer-facing technical delivery.
* **AI Engineer:**
  Owns reusable user-facing AI features and AI-powered application experiences.
* **AI Agent Engineer:**
  Owns agent orchestration, behavior, tool workflows, and core agent capabilities.
* **Data & AI Engineer:**
  Owns data connectivity, schema and metadata systems, semantic representations, and cross-database data correctness.
* **NLP/ML Engineer:**
  Owns model-level NLP and generation quality, including SQL-generation capabilities.
* **Platform Engineer:**
  Owns infrastructure, model access, deployment systems, observability, security, and platform-level connectivity.
* **Backend Engineer:**
  Owns core backend services, APIs, business logic, and shared application services.

The Forward Deployed Engineer configures and extends existing capabilities, validates customer deployments, and escalates core product changes to the appropriate teams rather than maintaining customer-specific forks.

**Customer Engagement Expectations**

* Work directly with customers across different technical and business environments.
* Support customer meetings and deployments across relevant time zones when required.
* Be willing to travel for customer meetings, workshops, deployments, and go-live activities when necessary.
* Manage multiple implementation activities while maintaining clear priorities and communication.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3–5 years of experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, data engineering, AI engineering, technical consulting, or a related technical role.
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.
* Experience with APIs, databases, backend services, enterprise applications, and data integrations.
* Strong understanding of data workflows, SQL, and technical troubleshooting.
* Experience working with customers, stakeholders, or cross-functional technical teams.
* Familiarity with LLMs, Generative AI, and AI-powered applications.
* Ability to translate customer requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to investigate issues using logs, errors, configurations, and reproduction steps.
* Strong communication skills and comfort supporting customer environments and production deployments.
* Ability to manage multiple requirements and competing priorities effectively.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Technical Consulting, or Technical Implementation.
* Experience supporting product demonstrations, pilots, or proofs of concept.
* Experience with AI analytics, natural-language-to-SQL, or enterprise data applications.
* Experience with AI agents, tool calling, or agentic workflows.
* Familiarity with LangGraph, LangChain, or LlamaIndex.
* Experience with MCP and AI assistant integrations.
* Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks.
* Experience with Docker and cloud or deployment platforms such as AWS, Azure, GCP, Render, or Vercel.
* Experience with production deployments, AI evaluation, regression testing, observability, or production AI troubleshooting.

**Key Skills**

Python | SQL | APIs | Databases | Enterprise Data | System Integration | Generative AI | LLMs | AI Applications | Natural-Language-to-SQL | Data Analytics | AI Agents | MCP | Docker | Cloud | Customer Deployment | Production Troubleshooting | Technical Implementation | Technical Communication

**Why Join Trida Labs?**

At Trida Labs, you will work directly on real AI systems solving enterprise data and analytics problems.

You will collaborate with customers and engineering teams across solution design, AI implementation, enterprise data integration, evaluation, production troubleshooting, and product improvement—helping turn real customer requirements into reliable, reusable product capabilities.
