description:
**What Makes Us, Us**
 Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
   

  

 At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success\-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people\-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
   

  

 If you like what we're saying, keep reading!
   

  

 WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US
   

  

 As a Product Engineer with 10 years of experience, you sit at the intersection of product thinking and engineering execution. You own the full arc of a feature — from understanding the problem, to building a working prototype, shipping and delivering its outcome. You bring both the business knowledge of what to build and the technical depth to ensure it is built well, with a personal stake in quality at every stage
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
 Product Value Delivery
   

  

* Translate business goals and user needs into product opportunities with clear value hypotheses.
* Prototype solutions early and often — directly, to validate ideas before committing to full build
* Define scope collaboratively with stakeholders, keeping scope anchored to user value rather than feature count.
* Track and communicate the impact of what ships; deliver outcome, not just the output.


 Engineering Quality
   

  

* Write and review technical requirements and acceptance criteria that leave no ambiguity at implementation time.
* Assess feasibility early and frame build\-vs\-integrate trade\-offs in terms of delivery impact, risk, and value — enabling informed decisions across product and engineering.
* Be the last line of defense on quality: review and test deliverables against requirements, run validation, and hold the bar.
* Identify and highlight technical debt and systemic risks before they become delivery blockers.
* Keep system documentation live and accurate — treated as a product asset, not an afterthought.


 AI\-Enabled Development
   

  

* Use AI tools (Copilot, Claude, and others) fluently as part of your everyday working routines.
* Critically evaluate AI\-generated artifacts — verify correctness and architectural fit before accepting.
* Guide your team on responsible AI usage: when to trust it, when to override it, and how to review it carefully
* Identify where AI can accelerate prototyping cycles and reduce low\-value work in the team.


 Team Agile Practices
   

  

* Maintain a healthy, prioritized product backlog — each item sized, scoped, and ready for the team.
* Work closely with software engineers during implementation — unblock, review, and course\-correct in real time
* Be the connective tissue between stakeholders and the delivery team: clear in both directions.


**What We Are Looking For**
 An experienced Product Engineer doesn’t wait for a spec to be handed to them — they shape it. They prototype before they present, validate before build, and measure after ship. They push back on scope that doesn't serve users, and they focus on quality that does. They make the team faster by removing ambiguity, not by adding process.
   

  

**Skills Experience**
* Strong software engineering fundamentals in development and testing disciplines.
* Demonstrated ability to move from problem statement to working prototype quickly.
* Experience writing precise technical requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Hands\-on quality assurance: test design, validation, and defect triage.
* Experience working directly with clients or external counterparties.
* Solid grounding in financial instruments — Repos, Derivatives, or related collateral/securities product
* Comfortable running demos, gathering requirements from business users, and translating business workflows into system behaviour.
* Ability to frame engineering decisions in terms of user and business value.
* Comfort working in ambiguity and structuring problems before solving them.
* Strong stakeholder communication — able to translate freely between technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Regular use of AI coding assistants (Copilot, Claude, or equivalent) in a professional context.
* Demonstrated critical evaluation of AI\-generated outputs — not just accepting but interrogating them.
* Understanding of AI limitations relevant to software delivery: hallucination, context loss, security blind spots.
* Agile practitioner: fluent in Scrum ceremonies, backlog management, and iterative delivery.
* Strong documentation habits; treats the knowledge base as part of the product.
* Collaborative by default, decisive when needed.


**Benefits**
* Global hybrid work policy — We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose, you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* Growth and innovation — Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team, or the organization.
* Self\-Direction — High degree of self\-organization. Each team member has a high degree of freedom to plan, organize, and design their work.
* Inclusive and diverse company culture.
* Work\-life balance — We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace.
* Empowerment — We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes.

 In addition to managing your own portfolio, you will help scale Site Agent across BrightEdge's customer base by leading new deployments, supporting strategic renewals, mentoring teammates, and contributing to product innovation.
 



  





**Mandatory Requirement:** 
 This role requires regular customer\-facing coverage during
 **U.S. Eastern Standard Time (EST) and Pacific Standard Time (PST) business hours** 
 . Candidates must be able to consistently support customers across these time zones as part of their regular working schedule.
 



  





  





**What You'll Do** 




  





**Customer Portfolio Ownership** 



* Own and manage a portfolio of Site Agent customer accounts across both New Logo and Existing Customer business.
* Take accountability for customer health, adoption, satisfaction, and retention.
* Conduct regular customer touchpoints and quarterly business/performance reviews.
* Identify optimization opportunities and recommend SEO best practices to improve customer outcomes.

**Implementation \& Technical Delivery** 



* Lead end\-to\-end Site Agent implementations from kickoff through production deployment.

* Client\-side JavaScript integrations
* Server\-side SDK implementations
* Sidecar and custom deployment models
* Coordinate technical discovery sessions with customers.
* Manage implementation timelines, milestones, risks, and stakeholder communication.
* Ensure successful production launches and post\-launch validation.



  





**Platform Configuration \& Optimization** 




 Configure and maintain Site Agent including:
 


* Profiles
* Source and target rules
* Priority ordering
* Anchor text logic
* Regex configuration
* Language settings
* Crawl configuration
* Page and link caps
* Additional domains



 Maintain high configuration accuracy, recognizing that every change is reflected on customer\-facing websites.
 



  





**Technical Troubleshooting** 



* Diagnose implementation and production issues using:
* Crawl data
* Site Agent Admin Panel
* Debug tools
* Regex validator
* Resolve implementation issues independently whenever possible.
* Escalate complex engineering issues with detailed technical documentation.
* Coordinate resolution of "AP Down" customer accounts and restore production health.



  





**Customer Success \& Strategic Consulting** 



* Conduct Quarterly Site Agent Performance Reviews.
* Review implementation health and KPIs.
* Deliver SEO recommendations based on customer performance.
* Reinforce the value of Site Agent automation, especially during periods of flat or declining performance.
* Support executive customer presentations including QBRs and EBRs.



  





**Cross\-Functional Partnership** 




 Collaborate closely with:
 


* Customer Success Managers
* Strategic Account Managers
* Sales
* Professional Services
* Product Management
* Engineering



 Support:
 


* Strategic renewals
* Competitive positioning
* Product adoption
* Technical discovery
* Executive customer presentations



**Product Growth \& Innovation** 



* Support rollout of new Site Agent capabilities including AP Schema and Site Agent for Mobile.
* Deploy Site Agent across new Enterprise and Mid\-Market customers.
* Participate in product feedback sessions with Engineering.
* Contribute to implementation playbooks and best practices.
* Share customer insights to influence future product direction.



**Team Leadership** 



* Mentor junior Implementation Specialists.
* Provide technical guidance during complex customer engagements.
* Share troubleshooting knowledge and implementation best practices.
* Support onboarding and cross\-training initiatives.



  





  





**Required Qualifications** 



* 5\+ years of experience in Technical Customer Success, Professional Services, Technical Implementation, Solutions Consulting, or SEO technology.
* Experience managing Enterprise customer relationships.
* Strong project and program management experience.
* Excellent executive communication and presentation skills.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent customer implementations.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities.
* Experience documenting work in Salesforce or similar CRM systems.



  





  





**Preferred Technical Experience** 




 Experience with one or more of the following:
 


* JavaScript integrations
* Server\-side implementations
* SDK integrations
* REST APIs
* Regular Expressions (Regex)
* HTML/CSS fundamentals
* CMS platforms (Sitecore, Shopify, WordPress, Adobe Experience Manager, etc.)
* React and modern web frameworks
* Website architecture
* Rendering concepts (client\-side vs server\-side)



  





  





**SEO Knowledge** 




 Working knowledge of:
 


* Internal linking
* Technical SEO
* On\-page optimization
* Structured Data / Schema
* Crawl behavior
* Website architecture
* Search engine indexing



  





  





**What Makes You Successful** 




 You are someone who:
 


* Thrives in customer\-facing technical environments.

description:
**Role Overview**  

We are seeking a talented Full Stack Data Engineer to join our growing Data \& Analytics team.


This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys building data solutions end\-to\-end—from ingesting and transforming raw data through to modelling, visualization, and delivering actionable business insights. You will work closely with stakeholders across Commercial, Operations, Finance, and Corporate Functions to translate business requirements into scalable data products built on the Microsoft Fabric ecosystem.


The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with a business\-oriented mindset and enjoys owning solutions throughout their lifecycle.

**Note: Role will require supporting EU/US time zones. Flexibility in working hours is to be expected**

**About Role**

**1\. End\-to\-End BI Solution Development**

* Design, develop, and implement full\-stack BI solutions from data ingestion through to user\-facing reports and apps.
* Take ambiguous business questions and translate them into well\-defined BI products, including data models, semantic layers, dashboards, and supporting documentation.
* Manage delivery from discovery and prototyping through validation and production support.
* Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and reliability across all BI solutions.

**2\. Data Pipelines, Modelling, and ETL**

* Develop and maintain ingestion and transformation pipelines using Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory pipelines, dataflows Gen2, copy activities).
* Land, organize, and structure data using Fabric Lakehouse and/or Data Warehouse patterns.
* Implement layered data architectures (e.g. bronze / silver / gold) to ensure modular, reusable, and testable transformations.
* Partner with Data Engineers to align on ETL standards, performance optimization, and scalable design.
* Apply data quality checks, validation rules, and monitoring to proactively identify issues.

**3\. Semantic Models, Reporting, and Visualization**

* Design dimensional and star schemas optimized for BI use cases (facts, dimensions, SCDs, conformed dimensions).
* Build and maintain Power BI semantic models (datasets) with clear, consistent business logic using DAX measures and calculated columns.
* Develop high\-quality Power BI reports, dashboards, and apps that are intuitive, performant, and aligned to real business workflows.
* Implement navigation, drill\-through, parameterized views, and security (row\-level and object\-level) as required.
* Optimize models and reports for performance, maintainability, and scalability.

**4\. Data Analysis and Insights**

* Perform data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities that support decision\-making.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand analytical needs and deliver actionable insights.
* Support advanced analytics use cases where appropriate, including predictive or statistical models in partnership with other specialists.

**5\. Data Governance, Documentation, and Support**

* Ensure BI solutions comply with data governance policies, security standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Contribute to and follow standards for naming, workspace structure, environments, and deployment flows in Fabric.
* Document BI products clearly, including purpose, data sources, refresh cadence, ownership, lineage, and known limitations.
* Contribute to shared libraries of reusable calculations, templates, and visual standards.
* Provide structured handovers, user support, and occasional training or knowledge\-sharing sessions.

**6\. Collaboration and Continuous Improvement**

* Work closely with business stakeholders to priorities work and agree success measures for BI products.
* Collaborate with data engineering, architecture, governance, and security teams to align on standards and patterns.
* Participate in peer reviews of SQL, DAX, data models, and report designs.
* Support continuous improvement of BI delivery practices, promoting full\-stack ownership and reduced hand\-offs.

**About You**

* Strong proficiency in SQL for data transformation, modelling, and performance tuning.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric components, including:
* *Data Factory (pipelines, dataflows Gen2\)*
* *Lakehouse and/or Data Warehouse*
* *Power BI datasets, reports, and apps*
* Strong Power BI skills, including DAX, semantic modelling, and performance optimization.
* Solid understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modelling concepts.
* Experience implementing BI security models (e.g. RLS).
* Familiarity with Git\-based source control and CI/CD practices for BI and analytics assets.
* Experience working with enterprise source systems (e.g. ERP, CRM, finance systems).

**Analytical and Professional Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Clear communication skills, able to explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Strong attention to detail, documentation, and data quality.
* Ability to work effectively in a cross\-functional, collaborative environment.
* Comfortable working in regulated or compliance\-driven environments.

**Education/ Qualifications**

* Bachelor/Master in relevant field (e.g. Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering), or equivalent practical experience.
* Proven experience (typically 3\+ years) in a BI, analytics, or data engineering role delivering end\-to\-end BI solutions.
* Demonstrated experience working across the full BI stack, from data ingestion and modelling to reporting and user adoption.

description:
Experience : 6\+ Years

**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking an experienced Java Full Stack Engineer to provide L3 application support, manage security vulnerabilities, implement application enhancements, and ensure the stability, performance, and compliance of enterprise applications. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, modern front\-end frameworks, cloud technologies, and production support processes.
 



 The role requires ownership of critical production incidents, security remediation, root cause analysis, and collaboration with development, infrastructure, security, and business teams to maintain application reliability and availability.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**L3 Production Support** 



* Provide L3 support for business\-critical applications and resolve production incidents within agreed SLA commitments.
* Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues and implement permanent corrective actions.
* Troubleshoot application, API, integration, middleware, infrastructure, and database\-related issues.
* Support Severity 1 and Severity 2 incidents, including war\-room participation and on\-call support when required.
* Analyze application logs, metrics, alerts, and monitoring dashboards to proactively identify issues.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, middleware, database, security, and vendor teams during incident resolution.



**Vulnerability \& Security Management** 



* Review, prioritize, and remediate vulnerabilities identified through application, dependency, infrastructure, and code\-security scans.
* Address security findings aligned with OWASP Top 10 and enterprise secure\-coding standards.
* Coordinate with Security and Compliance teams to ensure vulnerabilities are closed within defined remediation timelines.
* Perform impact assessment, code changes, regression testing, and deployment for third\-party library upgrades and security patches.
* Maintain evidence and technical documentation required for security reviews and audits.
* Support periodic patching, dependency upgrades, certificate renewals, and secure configuration reviews.



**Development \& Enhancements** 



* Develop, maintain, and enhance Java applications using Spring Boot and microservices architecture.
* Build and support user interfaces using ReactJS or Angular, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3\.
* Design and develop secure RESTful APIs and backend services.
* Implement production bug fixes, minor enhancements, technical\-debt remediation, and performance improvements.
* Participate in code reviews, unit testing, and adherence to coding and architecture standards.



**DevOps, Monitoring \& Performance** 



* Support CI/CD pipelines, release activities, rollback planning, and deployment automation across environments.
* Work with Docker and Kubernetes or equivalent container platforms for application deployment and support.
* Develop scripts and operational automation to reduce manual effort and improve reliability.
* Monitor application health using tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, CloudWatch, or the ELK stack.
* Perform application and database performance analysis, tuning, and capacity\-related troubleshooting.



**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




**Technical Skills** 



* Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 6\+ years of experience in Java full\-stack development and enterprise application support.
* Strong experience with Java 11/17\+, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, Hibernate/JPA, and microservices.
* Front\-end development experience with ReactJS or Angular, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3\.
* Experience developing and supporting REST APIs and system integrations.
* Strong SQL skills with PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL.
* Hands\-on experience with Git, Maven or Gradle, and CI/CD tools.
* Experience with AWS, Azure, or another cloud platform, plus Docker and Kubernetes.



**Support \& Security Experience** 



* Strong experience in L3 production support, incident management, problem management, and root cause analysis.
* Experience with ticketing and work\-management tools such as ServiceNow or Jira.
* Proven experience in vulnerability remediation, dependency upgrades, patching, and secure coding.
* Working knowledge of OWASP Top 10 and application security principles.
* Ability to interpret logs, thread dumps, heap dumps, performance metrics, and security scan findings.



**Professional Skills** 



* Strong analytical, diagnostic, and troubleshooting abilities.
* Clear verbal and written communication with technical and business stakeholders.
* Ability to work effectively with global onshore and offshore teams.
* Ability to manage incidents, vulnerabilities, enhancements, and planned releases in parallel.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience in healthcare, financial services, or another regulated industry.
* AWS, Azure, Java, or security\-related certification.
* Experience with SonarQube, Veracode, Checkmarx, Snyk, Tenable, Qualys, or similar tools.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery and Site Reliability Engineering practices.
* Experience with automated testing tools such as JUnit, Mockito, Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright.



**Key Success Measures** 



* Adherence to incident\-response and resolution SLAs.
* Timely remediation and closure of security vulnerabilities.
* Reduction in repeat incidents through effective root cause elimination.
* Application availability, stability, security, and performance.
* Successful delivery of bug fixes, enhancements, patches, and releases.



 Compliance with security, audit, documentation, and change\-management requirements.

You will build complete, production\-ready applications end to end, combining solid Python and Java engineering with modern front\-end development and Generative AI, RAG, and Agentic AI capabilities.
 



 You will own work across the full lifecycle: business requirements, solution design, backend development, database and vector store, LLM and agent integration, APIs, user interface, testing, cloud deployment, and production support. This is not a research, notebook\-only, or model\-experimentation role.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 ·       Design and develop AI\-powered enterprise applications, assistants, copilots, intelligent search, and workflow automation solutions.
 



 ·       Integrate commercial and open\-source LLMs into production systems using prompt engineering, context engineering, structured outputs, tool and function calling.
 



 ·       Build end\-to\-end RAG pipelines covering document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector storage, hybrid and semantic retrieval, metadata filtering, reranking, context construction, evaluation, and hallucination reduction.
 



 ·       Build Agentic AI workflows including multi\-agent systems, agent memory, planning, orchestration, supervisor agents, and human\-in\-the\-loop flows.
 



 ·       Develop backend services, REST APIs, and microservices in Python (FastAPI, Flask, Django) and Java (Spring Boot), with proper authentication, validation, error handling, logging, and versioning.
 



 ·       Build responsive front\-end interfaces with React or Angular and wire them to backend and AI services, including streaming LLM responses, chat interfaces, and authentication flows.
 



 ·       Design and work with relational, NoSQL, and vector databases.
 



 ·       Deploy, monitor, and support applications on Azure, AWS, or GCP using Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and standard observability tooling.
 



 ·       Build reusable AI services and components, and evaluate emerging AI frameworks and models for adoption.
 



 ·       Contribute to AI\-powered automation and quality engineering initiatives such as test generation, defect triage, root cause analysis, and self\-healing automation.
 



 ·       Translate business requirements into technical solutions, build rapid POCs, and convert successful POCs into production applications.
 



  





**Required Qualifications** 




  





 ·       3\+ years of professional software development experience.
 



 ·       Strong hands\-on Python development, writing maintainable production code (not limited to notebooks).
 



 ·       Hands\-on Java and Spring Boot development experience.
 



 ·       Proven experience designing and building REST APIs and backend services.
 



 ·       Full stack application development experience, including hands\-on front\-end work with JavaScript or TypeScript and React or Angular, plus HTML and CSS.
 



 ·       Strong SQL and relational database experience (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, or Oracle).
 



 ·       Hands\-on Generative AI / LLM integration experience in real applications.
 



 ·       Experience building or contributing to RAG\-based applications.
 



 ·       Hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
 



 ·       Proficiency with Git and strong software engineering fundamentals.
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




  





 ·       4 to 7 years of overall IT experience, including 2\+ years each in Python and Java application development.
 



 ·       Hands\-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, or Semantic Kernel.
 



 ·       Experience building and deploying AI agents in production.
 



 ·       Vector database experience: Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, FAISS, pgvector, Azure AI Search, or OpenSearch.
 



 ·       Microservices architecture, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD (Jenkins or GitHub Actions).
 



 ·       Practical ML understanding (classification, regression, clustering, feature engineering, model evaluation and deployment) with Scikit\-learn, XGBoost, or Hugging Face.
 



 ·       Test automation exposure: Playwright, Selenium, RestAssured, PyTest, TestNG, JUnit, or Postman.
 



 ·       Data engineering exposure: PySpark, Kafka, Airflow, Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, ETL/ELT pipelines.
 



 ·       Databricks experience: Delta Lake, Medallion Architecture, Unity Catalog, Workflows, Databricks SQL.
 



 ·       Monitoring and observability tools: Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, Azure Monitor, CloudWatch.
 



  





**Nice to Have** 




  





 GraphRAG, fine\-tuning and LoRA/PEFT, TensorFlow, PyTorch, MLflow, Terraform, JMeter or performance testing, Appium, Next.js, state management libraries, component design systems, and multi\-cloud experience.
 



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




  





 You are a hands\-on coder who is comfortable in both Python and Java, capable of building the user interface as well as the services behind it, curious about emerging AI technologies, and able to independently ship a feature from design through to production. You troubleshoot on your own, learn new frameworks quickly, and collaborate easily with product owners, architects, QA engineers, UI developers, and client teams.
 



  





**Education** 




  





 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or Engineering, or equivalent hands\-on software development experience.

 We serve 2,000\+ physicians and healthcare providers, delivering measurable outcomes, 20–30% fewer no\-shows and thousands of staff hours saved. Now, we're scaling our AI platform and we want you to help lead that charge.
   

  

****Role Overview****
 Lead complex full\-stack system design and delivery. Own technical decisions, raise the engineering bar, and drive AI\-powered feature development across React and Python. A hands\-on senior engineer who shapes architecture and mentors the team.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
**Architecture \& Technical Leadership**
* Architect and build complex, scalable full\-stack features end\-to\-end
* Make and document key technical decisions (frameworks, patterns, APIs, data models)
* Design robust backend services in Python and data models for performance and scale
* Identify and resolve performance, reliability, and scalability bottlenecks


**AI Systems**
* Lead AI/LLM\-driven feature integration into production (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini APIs)
* Architect agentic workflows, RAG systems, and conversational AI features
* Define LLM integration patterns and best practices for the team


**Quality, SDLC \& Mentorship**
* Drive code quality through reviews, standards, and testing strategy
* Shape SDLC practices and engineering standards across the team
* Mentor mid\-level engineers on technical challenges and architecture
* Leverage AI coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code) for velocity
* Partner closely with product and design on roadmap and scope


****Requirements****
* 4–6 years full\-stack engineering
* Expert TypeScript/JavaScript and modern frontend framework (React preferred)
* Strong backend expertise: Python (FastAPI/Django) and system design
* LLM/agentic systems integration in production (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini)
* Proven experience architecting scalable web applications
* Deep databases, caching, and API design at scale
* Track record mentoring engineers and leading technical initiatives
* Strong ownership mindset and AI\-first working style


**Nice\-to\-Have**
* Event\-driven and real\-time architectures (WebSockets, SSE, Kafka)
* Cloud and DevOps fluency for end\-to\-end ownership (AWS/GCP, Docker, K8s)
* SDLC leadership: standards, testing strategy, developer experience
* Healthcare technology or health\-tech startup experience


**Why Join Interactly.ai?**
* Build infrastructure and products powering real\-world healthcare AI
* Work with AI\-native engineering teams using cutting\-edge tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot)
* Mission\-driven impact — improve patient outcomes and save thousands of staff hours
* High ownership, rapid learning, and significant career upside
* Global collaboration across India and the US
* Seed\-stage growth — scale from Seed to Series A alongside the team

title: Fullstack AI Quality Engineer – Applied & Agentic AI Systems
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

 External Job Ad Text
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are seeking a highly skilled AI Quality Engineer specializing in testing Generative (and non\-Generative) AI applications and agentic systems to join our team. The ideal candidate will have expertise in both traditional software testing and specialized testing methodologies for Large Language Models (LLMs)\-based and AI\-based systems.
   

  

 As a fullstack Quality Engineer within a lean, agentic software team, you will cover the entire spectrum of quality assurance. You will span manual exploratory testing, traditional automated UI/API/MCP testing (across our Python and TypeScript stack), classical machine learning validation, and cutting\-edge generative and agentic AI evaluation. This role requires a deep understanding of LLM, agentic and ML systems behaviors, and testing frameworks to ensure the reliability, fairness, and effectiveness of our AI\-powered solutions.
   

  

**Description Of The Area**
 At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. The Applied AI Engineering Team focuses on architecting, building, and operating high\-value AI solutions and services to solve complex business challenges in healthcare.
   

  

 In the 2026 tech landscape, we operate in small, highly autonomous agile teams (e.g., \~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before. In this highly regulated environment, quality cannot be an afterthought. You will be the foundational pillar ensuring our rapidly developed agentic workflows and AI, GenAI, and agentic applications are safe, compliant, and robust before they reach the clinical or enterprise user.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Generative \& Agentic AI Testing Strategy: Design and implement comprehensive testing strategies specifically tailored for LLM\-based applications and agentic systems, including evaluation of model responses, RAG pipelines accuracy, and overall system reliability. You will expand this to evaluate autonomous multi\-agent behaviors and tool\-use accuracy
* Full\-Stack Test Automation: Design and implement automated testing solutions for continuous evaluation of LLM applications, including integration tests, performance tests, and specialized AI behavior tests. This spans both our Python backend services and modern TypeScript/React/Angular frontends
* Quality Assurance Framework \& Compliance: Utilize Roche's testing frameworks that address both traditional software quality aspects and AI\-specific concerns such as output consistency, contextual accuracy, and ethical compliance; co\-create and maintain such frameworks when required. Create and maintain comprehensive test documentation testing strategy, test cases, and testing guidelines specific to AI applications and compliant with Roche practices
* Edge Case, Bias, and Fairness Testing: Identify and develop test scenarios for edge cases in LLM behavior, including handling of ambiguous inputs, potential biases, and unexpected response patterns. Design and execute tests to identify potential biases in model outputs and ensure fair treatment across different user groups and use cases
* Security \& Performance Testing: Collaborate within development teams to test for potential vulnerabilities specific to LLM applications, including prompt injection, data leakage, and other AI\-specific security concerns. Collaborate with other engineers to conduct thorough performance testing of GenAI applications, including response time analysis, load testing, and resource utilization monitoring


**Qualifications**
* Hold B.Sc., B.Eng., M.Sc., M.Eng. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent degree with strong background in testing methodologies
* Be passionate about quality assurance and testing, particularly in the context of AI and GenAI applications and agents
* Have strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail
* Utilize critical thinking and problem\-solving when using AI prompts (in e.g. NLP, data distributions and edge cases)
* Be proactive in identifying potential issues and suggesting improvements


**Education / Experience**
* Experience: 7\+ years of experience in software testing, with at least 1 year focused on genAI and/or agentic applications
* Regulated Environments: Be ready to work in a regulated environment with qualified infrastructure and validated applications, understand the difference between GxP and non\-GxP products and the importance of CSV and ITSM processes in the delivery
* Agile Integration: Be experienced in working with Agile development teams


**Skills**
**Must\-have:**
* Comprehensive Full\-Stack Testing Mastery
* Core Languages \& Testing Frameworks: Advanced command of Python and standard testing frameworks (e.g., pytest, allure), alongside practical familiarity with specialized AI evaluation tools. High competence in TypeScript\-driven test frameworks (such as Playwright, Jest, and Cypress) for thoroughly verifying dynamic generative user interfaces
* End\-to\-End Automation \& CI/CD: Proven expertise in architecting and maintaining end\-to\-end automated testing suites that bridge traditional UI/API validation with complex, asynchronous AI/LLM evaluation pipelines
* Pipeline Integration: Hands\-on experience integrating these comprehensive suites within GitHub Actions or modern CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous, reliable quality checks throughout the entire development lifecycle
* Advanced AI Quality \& Evaluation Mastery
* AI Evaluation Frameworks: Expertise in implementing evaluation harnesses (e.g., RAGAS, DeepEval, Promptfoo) to quantify LLM performance, hallucination rates, and answer relevancy
* Agentic Workflow Validation: Ability to test autonomous agentic loops, including tool\-use accuracy, step\-by\-step reasoning verification, and goal\-directed performance metrics
* Evaluation Datasets: Experience in curating, managing, and versioning 'Golden Datasets' for benchmarking model responses against ground truth in both development and production environments
* Observability \& Feedback Loops: Leveraging tracing (e.g., LangSmith, Arize Phoenix) to monitor production inputs/outputs, identify drift, and capture user feedback for continuous improvement
* Basic broad AI knowledge: Understanding of LLM architectures, RAG systems, agents, and common failure modes in AI applications
* Python Expertise: Advanced proficiency in writing robust, maintainable Python code for test automation (e.g., pytest). Experience using Python to orchestrate complex AI evaluation workflows, process large datasets for benchmarking, and automate interactions with LLM/AI services. Ability to integrate Python scripts into CI/CD pipelines for automated quality checks and performance observability in agentic systems


**Should\-have:**
* Cloud: Practical experience with testing applications on cloud platforms (AWS) and working with cloud\-based AI services
* Observability \& ALM: Experience with monitoring and observability tools, log analysis, and performance metrics tracking (Grafana). Experienced in Roche mandatory ALM tools (Jira, GitHub)
* Agentic SDLC \& Engineering Excellence: Leverage AI coding assistants and autonomous agents (e.g., Claude Code, Ona) daily to accelerate full\-stack development and testing cycles. Conduct rigorous code reviews for both human\-written and AI\-generated code
* Security: Understanding of security testing methodologies, particularly in the context of AI applications


**Could\-have:**
* Regulatory Compliance: Proven understanding of AI quality assurance and testing standards within highly regulated industries


**Additional Qualifications**
* Stay current with the latest developments in AI and GenAI testing methodologies and best practices
* Have excellent communication skills and the ability to clearly document findings and recommendations
* Be able to communicate in English at the level of C1\+
* Located in Hyderabad, India, with working hours structured to capture the 'golden hours' of overlap with Central European Time (typically running through the IST evening)


 \#Hyd2026
   

  

 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.
   

  

**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

 ICE owns and operates the world's most advanced financial networks that are tasked with carrying market data around the world. Our networks are designed from the ground up to meet our unique performance constraints while remaining impeccably reliable. By joining the Infrastructure Development team you’ll aid us in maintaining the networks as well as helping us continue to push the envelope with state\-of\-the\-art technologies.

title: Fullstack UX/UI Researchers/Designer - Applied & Agentic AI Systems
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are recruiting a Senior Fullstack UX/UI Researcher \& Designer to serve as a pivotal member of our Applied AI function. This is a high\-impact Senior Individual Contributor (IC) role designed for an elite practitioner who prefers building and executing over administrative management. By intentionally merging deep user research and high\-fidelity UI design into a single "fullstack" discipline, you will solve the unique friction points created by non\-deterministic AI outputs. In an environment where AI behavior is fluid, the ability to unify discovery and delivery is essential. Your work—ranging from embedded enterprise chat to real\-time generative UI streams—will be the primary engine for establishing user trust, ensuring that unpredictable machine learning data is transformed into intuitive, systemic, and reliable human experiences. This role represents a critical evolution in Roche’s digital mission, bridging the gap between raw algorithmic power and meaningful user value.
   

  

****Description of the area****
 At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. As part of our strategic initiatives, we are enabling high\-value AI (with a strong focus on Generative AI and agentic AI) through fit\-for\-purpose platforms, services and applications. The Applied AI Engineering Team is tasked with building innovative AI applications, GenAI agents, and agentic foundations. We operate in small agile teams (e.g., \~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before.
   

  

****Job Responsibilities****
* UX Research \& User Advocacy: Conduct user research to understand target users, develop personas, and ensure that our interfaces are optimized for user needs. Actively engage with end\-users to understand their workflows and translate business needs into intuitive design concepts. Perform usability tests to iterate on design concepts, integrating user feedback for continuous improvements. Design and test complex workflows and conversational interactions, observing how users react to dynamic, non\-deterministic system outputs
* Systemic UI \& Conversation Design: Focus on enhancing interaction with AI\-driven features by crafting user experiences that are conversational, responsive, and human\-like. Shift from designing static, predictable layouts to creating flexible, dynamic interfaces that can gracefully handle unpredictable data, varying confidence intervals, and real\-time LLM streams. Develop innovative visualizations to represent outputs from AI models, allowing users to easily understand and interact with complex information. Apply a strong aesthetic sense to build interfaces that foster user trust, utilizing enterprise design systems to maintain visual consistency across all touchpoints
* Wireframing and Prototyping: Design wireframes, user flows, and prototypes for innovative AI\-driven applications, focusing on both desktop and mobile experiences
* Accessibility and Usability: Ensure that all designed interfaces are accessible, inclusive, and provide a seamless user experience. Apply best practices to accommodate diverse user needs


**Qualifications**
* Hold a degree in Interaction Design, Human\-Computer Interaction or related fields
* Be passionate about AI\-driven user experiences and interested in staying up\-to\-date with emerging trends in UX/UI and AI
* Have a "Golden Mean" profile: deep design fundamentals backed by an artistic inclination and deep empathy for the end\-user
* Be detail\-oriented and have excellent problem\-solving skills
* Demonstrate strong self\-management skills to work effectively \- take initiative in identifying and solving problems, managing time efficiently, and ensuring tasks are completed on schedule


****Education / Experience****
* General UX/UI Mastery: 7\+ years of UX/UI Design mastery, with a demonstrated evolution into designing for AI\-driven and agentic systems
* Research Autonomy: 3–5\+ years of dedicated, hands\-on experience in User Research, Usability Testing, or Product Design Research, with a proven ability to own projects from a brief to final stakeholder presentation
* AI Integration Experience: Demonstrated experience designing interfaces that incorporate Large Language Models (LLMs) and classical Machine Learning (e.g., conversational assistants and data exploration tools)
* Information Architecture: Experience developing user journey maps, sitemaps, and wireframes that inform AI\-driven user experiences


**Skills**
****Must\-have:****
 Be able to conduct an end\-to\-end journey from ideation to prototype and testing:
   

  

* Research Skills: Strong user research skills, including conducting interviews, usability testing, and A/B testing to validate designs
* Design Tools: Proficiency in Figma for creating wireframes, mockups, and prototypes. Design system knowledge
* Prototyping and Testing: Ability to create interactive prototypes and gather user feedback through testing


****Should\-have:****
* Developing experience: Basic software development skills to allow editing codebases, creating code solutions, and understanding created codebases
* aSDLC: Created working mockups, PoCs, PoVs, prototypes via Agentic Software Development Lifecycle tools and approaches like Claude Code and Codex
* CX Strategy \& Integration: Ability to map customer touchpoints and integrate broader Customer Experience (CX) strategy into the product lifecycle


**Could\-have:**
* Regulatory Compliance: Proven experience working within highly regulated industries
* Agentic SDLC Prototyping Interest: A desire to further specialize in exchanging code with engineers via agentic workflows to streamline the handoff process
* Leading \& Educating Others: Interest in contributing to the development of the broader UX community through mentorship and knowledge sharing


**Additional Qualifications**
* Communication: Strong communication skills to effectively articulate design decisions and user needs to stakeholders. Be able to communicate in English at the level of: C1\+
* Collaboration: Ability to work collaboratively in Agile AI product development teams
* Ethics \& Empathy: Strong understanding of responsible AI deployment, backed by deep empathy for the end\-user to foster trust and accessibility
* Located in Hyderabad, India, with working hours structured to capture the 'golden hours' of overlap with Central European Time (typically running through the IST evening)

 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.
